description: Description: Remote Our client is seeking a Knowledge Graph Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for a construction-focused ontology, knowledge graph, and AI knowledge platform. You will connect historical project and operational data across estimating, scheduling, project controls, field execution, equipment, cost, and lessons learned to create a reusable knowledge foundation that can support AI, GraphRAG, LLM, and agent-based applications. This role requires expertise in designing and building enterprise knowledge graphs and ontologies applied to modern AI use cases. Due to client requirements, applicants must be willing and able to work on a w2 basis. For our w2 consultants, we offer a great benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits, 401k with company matching, and life insurance. Rate: $100.00 to $120.00/hr. w2 JN -102026-109252 Responsibilities: Architect and develop an enterprise ontology and knowledge graph for complex construction and project data. Define relationships across projects, activities, estimates, schedules, cost codes, crews, equipment, quantities, production rates, risks, changes, and outcomes. Evaluate and incorporate relevant standards, including IFC, buildingSMART, LandInfra, and semantic web standards. Integrate enterprise data from multiple operational and project systems into the knowledge architecture. Design and guide GraphRAG, LazyGraphRAG, RAG, and AI agent architectures. Establish standards for ontology governance, provenance, entity resolution, cross-system mappings, and knowledge quality. Partner with domain SMEs, enterprise architecture, data engineering, AI engineering, and technology teams. Design experiments to evaluate whether structured enterprise knowledge improves AI answer quality compared with traditional RAG and LLM approaches. Experience Requirements: Strong experience in knowledge graph architecture, ontology development, semantic architecture, knowledge engineering, enterprise/data architecture, or AI/ML architecture. Hands-on experience working with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic modeling, or graph databases. Understanding of RAG/GraphRAG, LLMs, AI agents, and enterprise data integration. Experience defining relationships and mappings across complex, disparate enterprise data sources. Ability to translate complex business and operational concepts into scalable technical architectures. Strong communication skills and ability to work across both technical teams and business/domain SMEs.

description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Qui sommes-nous:

Burson, leader mondial de la communication, a pour mission de créer de la valeur pour ses clients par la gestion de leur réputation. Grâce à notre expertise, nos technologies de pointe, nos solutions d'intelligence artificielle et notre créativité, nous anticipons les risques en temps réel, identifions les insights générateurs de préférence et d'engagement, et accompagnons la transformation et la réussite de nos clients. Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

En rejoignant Burson, vous intégrez une communauté mondiale d'experts à la pointe de l'innovation.

Burson fait partie du groupe WPP (LSE/NYSE : WPP), spécialiste de la transformation créative. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur bursonglobal.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn et Instagram.

En tant qu’Account Director Relations Presse / Relations Publiques, vous pilotez la relation entre l’agence et vos clients et accompagnez au quotidien des équipes pluridisciplinaires.

À l’écoute des enjeux, des objectifs et des priorités de vos clients, vous les conseillez dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de leurs stratégies de communication, de relations presse et de relations publiques. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sur leurs problématiques, anticiper les opportunités comme les risques et transformer leurs enjeux de réputation en recommandations et plans d’action concrets.

Vos missions détaillées : 

1. Stratégie et conseil client

  • Stratégie de communication : concevoir, piloter et déployer des stratégies de relations presse et relations publiques, en cohérence avec les enjeux de communication et de réputation des clients.
  • Conseil stratégique : accompagner les clients de manière proactive et structurée sur leurs problématiques de notoriété, d’image, de réputation et de visibilité.
  • Relations presse : définir les stratégies médias et superviser leur mise en œuvre : identification des angles, ciblage des journalistes, prises de contact, organisation d’interviews, conférences ou événements presse et suivi des retombées.
  • Relations publiques : imaginer et piloter des dispositifs permettant de renforcer la visibilité et la réputation des clients auprès de leurs différentes parties prenantes.
  • Rédaction : concevoir et superviser la rédaction de recommandations stratégiques, plans de communication, communiqués et dossiers de presse, éléments de langage, tribunes, Q&A, briefs porte-parole et autres supports de communication.
  • Accompagnement des porte-parole : préparer et conseiller les dirigeants et experts dans leurs prises de parole et leurs interactions avec les médias.
  • Veille et compréhension des enjeux : suivre l’actualité, les évolutions sectorielles et les enjeux sociétaux susceptibles d’avoir un impact sur les clients afin d’identifier de nouveaux territoires de communication.

2. Pilotage des comptes et management

  • Relation client : être l’interlocuteur privilégié des clients, construire une relation de confiance durable et garantir la qualité du conseil et des livrables.
  • Pilotage des équipes : organiser et superviser le travail des équipes en veillant à la qualité des recommandations, au respect des délais et à la bonne allocation des ressources.
  • Excellence opérationnelle : garantir le niveau de qualité attendu sur l’ensemble des missions et assurer la bonne coordination des différentes expertises mobilisées.

3. Développement et pilotage commercial

  • Développement des comptes : identifier de nouvelles opportunités de conseil et de développement auprès des clients existants.
  • New Business : contribuer activement aux compétitions et propositions commerciales, de la réflexion stratégique jusqu’à la présentation orale.
  • Pilotage budgétaire : élaborer, négocier et suivre les budgets en veillant à l’équilibre entre ambitions clients, ressources mobilisées et rentabilité.
  • Représentation de l’agence : maîtriser et valoriser les différentes expertises de l’agence auprès des clients et prospects.

Profil recherché : 

  • Expérience : 6 à 8 ans d’expérience minimum en agence de relations presse, relations publiques ou communication.
  • Expertise métier : excellente maîtrise des relations médias et des relations publiques, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des enjeux de réputation et de communication des entreprises et des marques.
  • Culture médias : très bonne connaissance du paysage médiatique français et capacité à comprendre rapidement les sujets d’actualité et leurs implications pour les clients.
  • Polyvalence : vous êtes à l’aise aussi bien sur des problématiques de communication corporate et de réputation que sur des sujets de marque ou des lancements de produits.
  • Qualités rédactionnelles : excellente capacité à structurer une réflexion et à produire des contenus convaincants, précis et adaptés aux différents interlocuteurs.
  • Relation client : sens du conseil, capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance et à accompagner des interlocuteurs seniors.
  • Qualités personnelles : curiosité, sens de l’actualité, réactivité, rigueur, esprit d’équipe et capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément.

Votre place est chez Burson :

Notre vision est de faire de Burson la référence en matière de formation pour les professionnels de la communication créative et les leaders de demain. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant où les collaborateurs motivés et ambitieux peuvent développer leurs compétences, étendre leur réseau et élaborer des stratégies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Notre engagement envers le développement de nos talents se traduit par des opportunités de formation, des programmes de mentorat avec des leaders du secteur, et une culture d'entreprise stimulante et inclusive qui encourage la collaboration et l'innovation. Nous avons également mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fidélisation pour nos meilleurs talents. Nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs car nous sommes convaincus que leur réussite est aussi la nôtre.

Chez Burson, nous sommes une agence d'apprenants permanents. Nous savons que l'excellence en créativité et en communication exige une compréhension fine et nuancée. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons des collaborateurs talentueux de tous horizons et de toutes cultures. Ces talents sont essentiels pour concevoir des idées audacieuses, favoriser un dialogue constructif, créer des expériences enrichissantes et stimuler l'innovation pour nos clients. You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Atamis

Atamis is a growing software business based in Cardiff. We make source-to-contract procurement software that is trusted across the NHS and the wider public sector, and used by private sector organisations too. We have a strong customer base, a product our customers rely on every working day, and a clear ambition: to move from software that records and reports on procurement to software that does the work.

Every year the UK public sector spends hundreds of billions of pounds buying goods and services, and every pound is taxpayers’ money. Much of that buying is still slow and manual. Buying teams spend their week writing specifications, chasing quotes and justifying decisions, while suppliers, large and small, spend heavily on every bid. Atamis is on a mission to change how that work gets done. As we grow, our team is expanding so we can keep delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

About the role

You’ll lead Product and Technology as one function and report to the CEO. The big question is how procurement should work if it were designed around AI from scratch: what AI should do, what a person must decide, and how a buyer can trust and defend the result. You’ll answer that question, then build the product and the team that deliver it. You’ll also run the product our customers rely on every working day, with one roadmap and delivery they can plan around.

How software gets built is changing fast, and this role is at the front of it. You’ll rethink how we work from first principles, with AI at the centre. You’ll use AI in your own work every day and work directly with customers.

Key responsibilities

Vision and Strategy

  • Set the product and technology strategy for both our products, and be clear about what we won’t build.
  • Run one roadmap, balancing new capability, customer commitments and technical health.
  • Own the Product and Technology budget, from people to agent, cloud and model spend, and stop what isn’t working.
  • Find the new products and markets AI opens up for our data and procurement knowledge, and prove each one through early releases before we commit fully.

AI

  • Set the limits on how much AI does on its own, what it must prove before it does more, and what always stays with a person.
  • Set the quality bar AI must clear across our products before it reaches customers.
  • Give every use of AI a clear business case and a known cost.

Product and Commercial

  • Lead product management, make sure what our customers tell us shapes what we build, and judge our work by adoption, retention and revenue.
  • Make sure every idea reaches the team as a clear written scope, so product people, engineers and AI agents all start from the same understanding.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Support and Finance on go-to-market, so product decisions reflect demand and customer value.
  • Be accountable for a standard product that works well out of the box, with as little bespoke work around each customer as possible.

Technology and Delivery

  • Rethink how we build, from idea to release, with AI agents, automated testing and regular releases.
  • Be accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery across our products, and keep the CEO clear on what will ship and when, what it costs, and where we’re off track.
  • Lead large technical change in stages, with clear options and decision points, protecting existing customers throughout.
  • Own technical risk and compliance across our products, from architecture and security to regulation, so the CEO knows the risks we carry and what we’re doing about them.
  • Make the big platform and partner decisions for the company, including how much we depend on any one provider.

People

  • Line manage the Principal Product Manager, the Product Solutions Lead and the Lead Engineers across different locations and time zones, and build a culture of ownership, curiosity and straight talk.
  • Reshape roles, team structure and skills as AI changes the work, hire and develop people, build succession, and keep a way in for junior engineers.
  • Shape company strategy with the leadership team, and represent our direction to customers and partners.

Key requirements

Education

  • A degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • 10+ years building B2B software products, including senior leadership of product or development, and enough experience of the other to lead both.
  • You’ve brought AI into a real product, and can tell us how you judged its quality and cost, and which number it moved.
  • You’ve changed how a team works with AI, and can show what improved and what broke.
  • You’ve shaped go-to-market for a product, working closely with Sales and Marketing.
  • Experience of procurement, the public sector or regulated markets, of moving a product from bespoke to standard, or of leading teams across countries and time zones, would be an advantage.

Skills and Competencies

  • AI-fluent: you use AI in your own work every day, and know what it can and can’t do.
  • Commercial product judgement: you know what’s worth building, connect it to growth and customer value, and say no when it matters.
  • Technically credible: you can weigh up architecture, quality and risk for yourself, and earn the respect of engineers.
  • First-principles thinker: you question how things have always been done, form your own view from the evidence, and commit once the call is made.
  • People leadership: people who’ve worked with you want to work with you again

description:
Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables
L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.

Et tout commence par vous.

 

Missions

En tant qu’AI Strategist Manager, vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous définissez les processus cibles et la roadmap, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.

 

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA

Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. Lorsque c’est pertinent, vous conduisez des refontes de processus de bout en bout, en pensant lean avant de déployer l’IA et en mobilisant les équipes Engineering et AI Adoption pour les livrer. Vous concevez le modèle opératoire cible et sécurisez ses conditions de succès.

II. Analyses, business cases & prototypage

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse de la mission, business cases inclus, afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits, et vous revoyez le travail de l’équipe. Vous prototypez rapidement des cas d’usage pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

III. Delivery, livrables & collaboration

Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous produisez en autonomie des livrables de niveau C-suite et des synthèses exécutives, structurez la storyline et veillez au respect des standards de qualité Artefact. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

IV. Relation client & développement commercial

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de confiance des directeurs métiers et des responsables de projets (Comex-1) : vous cartographiez les rapports de force entre les parties prenantes, animez les restitutions pour emporter l’adhésion et maximiser le NPS client, et gérez les tensions et escalades en préservant la confiance. Vous détectez de nouveaux besoins sur le terrain, construisez le plan de développement du compte avec le Directeur ou le Partner et déclenchez de manière proactive des propositions pour développer les comptes existants, en contribuant aux propositions commerciales et aux soutenances.

V. Équipe & connaissances

Vous encadrez et faites grandir les consultants juniors et seniors, êtes counsellor de plusieurs collègues et participez au recrutement des futurs talents. Vous contribuez aussi à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des formations internes.

 

Profil recherché
Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision.

  • 5 à 8 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de missions complexes, de la vision aux résultats, avec des business cases qui résistent à l’examen d’un Comex.
  • Une solide compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers), avec la capacité de l’expliquer simplement à des dirigeants.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de projets de refonte de processus métier, avec une maîtrise avérée de certains processus métier.
  • Une expérience du développement commercial (propositions, développement de comptes, relation avec des décideurs de haut niveau).
  • Une expérience d’encadrement d’une équipe de consultants, avec le goût de faire grandir, de déléguer et de tirer l’équipe vers le haut.
  • Un état d’esprit de maker : aisance avec les outils technologiques actuels et capacité à prototyper rapidement des démos fonctionnelles (low-code, no-code, outils agentiques) qui rendent la valeur tangible pour le client.
  • Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

 

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement couvre l’intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : AI Strategy (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opératoires), Engineering (industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et AI Adoption (conduite du changement, montée en compétences, usage quotidien de l’IA).

Pour en savoir plus sur Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • De la stratégie à la réalisation

Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.

  • Une collaboration entre expertises

Occuper un rôle à la croisée de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (Engineering) et de l'humain (AI Adoption).

  • Piloter ce qui compte

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

  • Une trajectoire qui accélère

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

  3. Un business case de prototypage IA hands-on (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur
  4. Un jeu de rôle AI Strategist Manager (45'-60') avec un AI Strategist Directeur ou Partner
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30') avec un AI Strategist Partner ou Managing Partner

description: Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy. Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., UAE, Singapore and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X. Do you want to lead a data science team on a problem the industry has not solved yet, while still writing code yourself? Are you excited about building the data foundation for how compliance works when the customer is an autonomous agent rather than a person? Are you looking for a values led company where a small team is trusted with a question that matters commercially in months, not years? The impact you will have: You will lead data science inside Elliptic's Intelligence team, alongside Intelligence Collection, Research and Investigations, and Professional Services. This is deliberately a player-coach role with a prospect of scaling a team. At first you will lead a small team of data scientists and you are expected to own the team's direction, performance and growth. You will own the evidence for the models your team builds, and you will represent them at Elliptic's model risk governance forum. This is not a compliance tax bolted onto the technical work: it is the reason institutions trust our outputs. The reason we are hiring a lead as we add more data scientists is that a small team working on an unsolved problem needs someone who intrinsically understands the domain, not a layer of management above it. You will set what this team works on, hire the next people into it, and be the person whose technical judgement the team trusts because you can do the work yourself. What you will do: Lead and grow the team. Set objectives with your data scientists in the context of company strategy, own their performance and development, and be the manager who has the difficult conversation rather than deferring it. Level the team against Elliptic's Intelligence career framework and build real development paths. Hire the next data scientists. Own the hiring process end to end with support: levels, job descriptions, hiring plan, interview panel and bar, and the hiring decision. Team growth to seven to nine people over time depends on you getting this right early. Build the collection for the future of compliance. Take it from a directive to a specification to delivered data: define what good looks like, sequence the work, set the quality bar, and be honest about what the dataset does and does not support. Own model governance for your team's models. Keep the model inventory current and correctly tiered, make sure validation and testing evidence exists at the standard each tier requires, monitor for drift and act on threshold breaches, and submit material changes and production deployments for review with the testing artefacts attached. Own the remediation of issues raised against your models, to agreed deadlines. Lead Elliptic's data science work. Frame the research question, run the first experiments, and form a defensible view of what Elliptic needs to be able to do and by when. Bring that view to Intelligence leadership, the Chief Scientist and Product as a recommendation rather than as an open question. Stay technically hands on. Write code, review your team's work at the level of method rather than output, and make the method calls yourself when they matter. Own the team's existing commitments. The team's current work on clustering, attribution, heuristics and labelling continues to serve the platform. You own its reliability and its trade offs, and you decide what to stop. Work across functions. Partner with Intelligence Collection, Collection Engineering, Research and Investigations, the Chief Scientist, Product and Engineering, so that data science work lands as platform capability rather than as analysis nobody uses. Set the AI working standard for the team. Decide how your team uses AI in its engineering and research workflow, what must be verified and how, and hold the team to it. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: The collection plan delivered at a scale that supports real model or heuristic work, with a documented path to maintaining it. An agreed Elliptic position on the evolution of compliance systems, timed against expected industry demand, with the first capability work either underway or deliberately deferred with stated reasons. At least one data science hire made, and the existing levelled against the career framework with development plans in place. Model governance in good standing for everything your team owns: inventory current and correctly tiered, no overdue validations on the highest tiers, monitoring in place with acted-upon thresholds, and no open issues past their remediation deadline. Data science objectives for Intelligence agreed and delivering, with other functions able to state what they can expect from the team and when. A visible improvement in the reliability or throughput of the team's core output, attributable to a change you made. Technical credibility intact: the team takes your method judgements seriously because you can do the work. You will be a great fit here if you: Want to lead a team without leaving the technical work behind, and can say honestly where you draw that line. Are comfortable being accountable for a question nobody has answered yet, including for saying what you do not know. Treat management as the work rather than as overhead: objectives, feedback, development and difficult conversations included. Treat governance as part of building good models rather than as paperwork that follows them, and would rather surface a problem with your own model than have someone else find it. Are pragmatic about trade offs between rigour and speed, and can explain the trade off you chose. Make other teams more effective rather than treating them as consumers of your team's output. Are curious about how the company operates beyond your own function. Care about the mission of using intelligence to fight financial crime and protect the global financial system. Our ideal candidate has: AI fluency, which is essential for this role. You must be able to demonstrate how you apply AI tools and approaches within a data science workflow: writing and debugging code, exploring unfamiliar data, accelerating pipeline and model work, and automating repetitive tasks. You must also be able to show how you critically evaluate the output, where you would not rely on it, and how you set verification expectations for a team rather than only for yourself. This is assessed in a dedicated stage of the interview process, working with your own tooling. Demonstrated experience managing data scientists or machine learning engineers: setting objectives, owning performance including underperformance, and developing people. You can point to someone whose career changed because of how you managed them. Experience hiring into a technical team, including defining the bar rather than only sitting on panels. Deep, hands on data science and machine learning capability that is current. Strong Python and SQL, and the ability to interrogate large behavioural or transactional datasets yourself and defend your method under challenge. A track record of taking an ambiguous question to a delivered dataset, model or capability, including deciding what was good enough. Experience with a modern data stack comparable to ours: a cloud data lake, Spark or Databricks, and AWS. Clear communication with technical and non technical stakeholders, and the ability to cascade direction to a team so that each person knows why their work matters. Bonus Points for: Work on agentic systems, LLM agents or autonomous transaction flows, whether in compliance, payments, fraud or infrastructure. Experience building a large dataset or collection from nothing, including the unglamorous parts: schema decisions, quality checks, and maintenance. Blockchain or on chain data experience: clustering, attribution, heuristics, anomaly detection, mempool analysis, or research into privacy preserving systems. Experience in payments, fraud or risk data science, where the cost of a false negative is commercial rather than academic. Having grown a team from a few people to a full department, and being able to describe what broke on the way. A PhD or equivalent research training, or a record of published applied research. Experience in a regulated environment or with model risk management frameworks, whether in financial services, or as a vendor to it, or in another domain with equivalent assurance requirements. description: Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans. Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC? Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast. Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants. Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen. Wat ga je doen? Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast. Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams. Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners. Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw samen te werken met Commercial Finance. Inzichten vertaal je naar concrete acties. Je verhoogt de conversie door middel van A/B-testen, analyses van klantgedrag en continue optimalisatie van de kiosk-ervaring en productpresentatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat campagnes, producten en waardeproposities effectief worden gepresenteerd en correct worden gelanceerd op de kiosken. Daarbij optimaliseer je de menustructuur, productzichtbaarheid en upsell- en cross-sellmogelijkheden. Je houdt platformproblemen in de gaten en werkt samen met IT en technologiepartners om deze op te lossen. Je werkt intensief samen met Operations om het gebruik van de kiosken en de uitvoering in de restaurants te verbeteren. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega's van Digital, Brand, Innovation, IT, Commercial en externe partners. Over KFC Nederland Kentucky Fried Chicken, de Amerikaanse restaurantketen gespecialiseerd in fried chicken, is sinds 1972 actief in Nederland. Inmiddels telt Nederland 96 KFC-restaurants. Dagelijks bereiden onze chefs verse kip- en vegetarische gerechten volgens het originele recept uit 1939 van oprichter Colonel Harland Sanders. description: At Marso, as an Embedded Software Architect, you will define and own the architecture of the software that runs on the Marso robot: from real-time control and hardware interfaces to the middleware that hosts perception, autonomy and manipulation. You will make sure the robot's software is reliable, safe, maintainable and ready to scale to a growing fleet. Responsibilities Define and maintain the embedded software architecture of the robot: layers, components, real-time constraints, communication between processes and hardware interfaces. Turn the system requirements and the integrated technical roadmap into a software architecture, working with Product & Systems and the CTO. Set and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, design reviews, testing strategy and documentation. Design how AI models from Intelligent Robotics are integrated, deployed and monitored on the robot. Own software reliability and safety: fault handling, watchdogs, diagnostics, logging and contributions to safety analyses. Participate in defining the build, release and deployment chain for embedded software (CI/CD, versioning, over-the-air updates, fleet configuration). Lead technical choices on operating systems, middleware, compute platforms and tools. Mentor embedded software engineers and act as the technical reference for the team. Profile 8+ years of experience in embedded software, including significant experience as an architect or tech lead on robotic, automotive or autonomous systems. Expert in embedded Linux with solid experience in real-time systems. Hands-on experience with robotics middleware and multi-process architectures. Experience integrating sensors, actuators and compute platforms. Strong knowledge of software quality and reliability practices: testing, CI/CD, observability and fault handling. Experience with functional safety or safety-oriented development. Ability to make and explain architecture decisions and to align engineers from several disciplines around them. Nice to have: experience with mobile robots or fleets in production, over-the-air updates, deploying AI models on embedded hardware. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background. Own your teams' delivery, working with Product, Design, QA and DevOps to ship high-quality work on time. Raise AI maturity across your team or teams against our maturity model, from prompt, context and harness practices towards agentic loops. Keep building with new tools yourself. Run incident response for your teams' systems and lead post-mortems. Take part in hiring, and support your engineers' performance and growth, including their AI fluency. Recent hands-on experience building working apps or tools with AI development tooling. Experience with agile practices, CI/CD and incident management. Clear communication, and the ability to link your team's work to business goals. Nice to have: Experience with agentic workflows eCommerce experience, especially with Shopify Laravel, PHP, React or AWS experience Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. About the role As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship. Responsibilities Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts. Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes. Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range. Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results. Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware. Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins. description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Your Mission As an Implementation Specialist at Hawk, your responsibility is to transform customer requirements into a functioning solution that helps them achieve their business objectives around transaction monitoring, customer screening and fraud detection, alongside cutting-edge AI technologies. You start with a signed contract and support the customer until go-live. This includes translating policies, regulatory obligations and risk factors into Hawk's setup, data mapping, workflow configuration, UAT support and ensuring that key project timelines and milestones are met. You support our customers in realising true value by detecting more financial crime, allowing investigators to focus on what matters instead of drowning in false positives, and adopting state-of-the-art AI technologies. Key Responsibilities Requirements and needs assessment: gather and analyse the customer's AML, fraud and screening requirements and advise on best-practice configuration. Configuration: translate policies, screening algorithms, regulatory requirements and risk factors into Hawk's setup, covering rules, screening, customer risk rating and workflows. Data mapping and integration: lead the technical deployment and integration with the customer's systems, via API or batch mechanisms. Testing and go-live: support the customer through testing, UAT and sign-off, troubleshoot issues, and support a successful transition to a production environment. Training and enablement: deliver training to the customer's teams from a functional as well as technical standpoint. Project management: plan and run the implementation from signature to go-live on time and within scope, with documentation and regular stakeholder updates, combining hands-on work with project leadership. Primary contact: be the first point of contact for implementation questions and issues. Collaboration and feedback: work closely with Customer Value Partners for a smooth implementation, and bring actionable customer feedback and gaps to Product, Development and Hawk's GTM organisation. Document every configuration decision and the reasoning behind it, so the setup holds up when the customer's auditor or regulator asks why a rule was set the way it was. Manage each implementation task and the implementation success as an outcome you own, as directed by our Customer Value Partner, resulting in activity completion and a go-live on the dates you committed to. Your Profile 6+ years in implementation consulting or solution consulting, with at least 3 of those years hands-on implementing AML, fraud or screening solutions. Subject matter expertise in AML and compliance. You are familiar with key typologies and patterns, the regulatory expectations behind them, and how monitoring programmes as well as AI get examined. You can confidently stand in front of an MLRO and discuss and defend a rule set. This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have. Hands-on data skills: SQL, APIs, CSV and JSON, and data modelling. You're familiar with standardised payment message formats, including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022, SEPA and card data. Integration literacy. You don't write production code, but you're at home with APIs, JSON payloads, SFTP configurations as well as SSO. Proven track record of taking complex implementations to go-live on time, ideally several in parallel, with banking customers or other financial institutions. Stakeholder alignment. You ensure that internal and external parties both have the information they need, keep them aligned and manage expectations. Able to explain complexity simply. Imagine data models for compliance leads, fraud typologies for data engineers. You do it clearly in writing and in the room, in fluent English. A degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Bonus Business-fluent German, for working with our DACH customers. CAMS (or equivalent) certification, or time spent in a second-line compliance or MLRO team. Builds constructive relationships with customers and stays calm and under pressure Builder mentality: works independently and brings structure to ambiguity where no established process exists, taking the initiative to define one. Is a resourceful problem-solver who investigates unknowns and tests system behaviour. Knows when and whom to escalate. Manages expectations proactively. Flags timeline and scope risks early, quantifies them, offers phased options and aligns Sales and Customer Success. Handles product gaps transparently. Clarifies the underlying (regulatory) requirement, offers workarounds with their trade-offs, feeds back to Product and doesn't commit to unconfirmed dates . You use AI tools such as Claude in your daily workflow to speed up mapping, documentation and analysis, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't. description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing advanced autonomous systems that rely on robust state estimation and sensor fusion to operate in complex, dynamic environments. Our platforms integrate multiple sensors (e.g., IMU, GNSS, vision, barometer, magnetometer) and require accurate, real-time estimation of system states (position, velocity, attitude, etc). Classical approaches such as Kalman filtering are powerful but rely on modeling assumptions that often break down in real-world conditions. To push performance beyond these limits, we are exploring hybrid approaches that combine model-based estimation with modern machine learning techniques. Your mission The goal of this internship is to explore and apply machine learning-based sensor fusion and state estimation methods to improve performance in dynamic environments. Responsibilities Literature review: Conduct a comprehensive review of existing ML methods for state estimation and sensor fusion. Algorithm Implementation: Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and computational overhead of the developed algorithms with classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions. Flight Tests Participation: Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record in applied mathematics, machine learning, robotics or a related fied. Knowledge of sensor fusion/state estimation is a strong plus. Technical Skills: Strong understanding of ML fundamentals. Experience with State Estimation, drones, or Control Theory is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. description: DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Contexte du stage Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ». Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place. Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie. Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe. Votre mission : L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées. Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse. Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus. Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont : • Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore • Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise • Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail. Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel. Informations importantes ð Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ; ð Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia. Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs. Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty. Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec. • Les étapes du recrutement seront les suivantes : 1er entretien avec Julie QUEIROS, DATA SCIENTIST chez Explore, accompagnée du personnel encadrant du laboratoire ; 2ème entretien et restitution de cas pratique avec Julie, accompagnée de son N+1 Steven HELLEC, ainsi que des encadrants du laboratoire ; 3ème et dernier entretien avec l’équipe RH, pour tout formaliser. Le profil que nous recherchons Étudiant·e de Master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Informatique / Mathématiques Information / Statistiques / Traitement du langage naturel / Data Science. Appétence à la recherche Connaissances en : Python, SQL, Méthodes de NLP Maîtrise de l’anglais Qualités de rédaction, d’analyse et d’autonomie appréciées. description: Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt. We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build. Het team en de uitdaging Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken. Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt. Hoe we werken 12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat. Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan: Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken. PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack. Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. description: We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! About the role Berlitz is rebuilding its commercial and financial platform. That includes a new CRM, usage-based billing, modern payment processing, and a consolidated ERP, all supporting new digital products for learners, teachers, and enterprise customers. We're looking for a Senior Financial Systems Engineer to own the flow of money through that platform, from quote and checkout through billing and payment to the general ledger. You'll be the technical authority on how our systems exchange financial data. You'll make sure every customer, invoice, payment, refund, and credit reconciles cleanly at month-end. This is a hands-on engineering role that sits at the intersection of engineering and finance. You'll report into Engineering and work day to day with Finance, RevOps, and our external NetSuite implementation partner. What you'll do Own the architecture and data contracts for our order-to-cash flow across HubSpot, Stripe, Adyen, Metronome, and NetSuite. Build and maintain integrations using NetSuite SuiteScript and REST/SuiteTalk, PSP APIs and webhooks, and our iPaaS (Workato), choosing custom code or low-code where each makes sense. Design reconciliation between payment processors, billing, bank settlements, and the ledger, and build the jobs, alerts, and audit trails that keep it reliable. Model prepaid credit packages and usage-based consumption correctly, including deferred revenue, drawdown, expiry, refunds, and credit notes. Support multi-entity, multi-currency operations, including subsidiaries, intercompany flows, FX, and tax handling. Act as the technical counterpart to our NetSuite implementation partner: review designs, challenge assumptions, and take ownership of what they build. Partner with Finance to shorten and de-risk month-end close by removing manual work and fixing data quality at the source. Document the financial data model and integrations so the platform is supportable beyond you. What you'll bring 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years building or owning financial, billing, or payments systems. Hands-on NetSuite development experience (SuiteScript 2.x, REST/SuiteTalk, saved searches) and a solid understanding of its record model, including customers, sales orders, invoices, payments, deposits, and journals. Production experience integrating Stripe and/or Adyen, including webhooks, idempotency, payouts and settlement reports, disputes, and fees. Real accounting literacy. You can explain revenue recognition, deferred revenue, cash application, and bank reconciliation, and you know why they matter to Finance. Strong integration engineering fundamentals: API design, event-driven patterns, retries and error handling, and data validation. Comfort working across teams and translating between engineers, accountants, and commercial stakeholders. Good judgement under deadline pressure, with the ability to ship pragmatically without creating reconciliation debt. Nice to have Experience with usage-based or consumption billing platforms (Metronome, Orb, Chargebee, or similar). Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRM-to-ERP integrations. iPaaS experience (Workato, Boomi, Celigo, MuleSoft). Experience migrating from a legacy billing or CRM system to a new stack. Exposure to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls around financial systems. Experience at a multi-country business or in education / subscription services. What success looks like First 90 days: You understand our current order-to-cash flows end to end. You've taken technical ownership of the payments-to-ledger integration and identified the biggest reconciliation risks. First 6 months: New products bill, collect, and post to NetSuite correctly across entities and currencies. Month-end reconciliation between PSPs and the ledger is largely automated. First year: Our financial systems are well documented, monitored, and trusted by Finance, and they're ready to scale to new products and markets. Why Berlitz A rare chance to shape a financial platform nearly from scratch at a global brand with a long history. Direct impact on how the company operates and reports, with high visibility across Engineering, Finance, and leadership. A team that values pragmatic engineering and cross-functional ownership. At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow. Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us. Working as part of a major capital delivery environment, you will be responsible for supporting the effective identification, assessment and management of project risks across a complex programme of work. You will work closely with Project Controls, Planning, Commercial, Cost and Project Management teams to provide robust risk insight and help ensure that project decisions are informed by a clear understanding of uncertainty and exposure. This is a project risk-focused role, rather than an enterprise or corporate risk position. The successful candidate will have strong experience of quantitative risk analysis, QSRA, cost and schedule risk analysis and project risk modelling, ideally gained within major construction, infrastructure, engineering or other complex capital programmes. About us CMR is first and foremost a team of people, passionate about the construction industry and changing the way project controls is provided. We are a progressive and dynamic consultancy offering tailored project controls services across a range of industries. Our Purpose (Why we exist): Inspiring new ways to help shape our construction industry. Our Ambition (What we want to achieve): Re-imagine project controls through a digital lens, being the obvious choice for clients and the place to grow together with intention. 🔹 What’s in it for you? At CMR you will have the opportunity to professionally develop like nowhere you have worked before. If you demonstrate the capability, our merit-based system will enable you to develop quickly. We use our in-house capability matrix to transparently track your progression and highlight development areas. Join our small, dynamic team where every member has the chance to make a significant impact, shaping the future direction of our company and making a real difference. We believe in rewarding our team for their achievements, celebrating our successes but equally helping each other when things are tough. The opportunity to work on a major, nationally significant infrastructure programme, gaining exposure to some of the most complex project risk challenges in the UK. 🔹 You’ll Lead and support the implementation of project risk management processes across complex infrastructure and construction projects. Own and maintain project risk registers, ensuring risks are clearly defined in terms of causes, events, impacts, probability, consequence and mitigation actions. Facilitate risk identification and review workshops with Project Management, Planning, Commercial, Engineering and other project stakeholders. Challenge project teams to ensure risks are appropriately identified, assessed, quantified and actively managed. Undertake and support Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA) and Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA) to assess the potential impact of uncertainty on project outcomes. Develop and maintain risk models, incorporating cost and schedule uncertainty, risk events, correlations and appropriate probability distributions. Support the development and review of risk allowances, contingency and management reserves, ensuring these are supported by robust quantitative analysis. Analyse project cost and schedule exposure and provide insight into P-values, confidence levels, ranges and potential outcomes. Integrate risk information with project cost and schedule data to provide a consolidated view of project exposure. Work closely with Planning and Project Controls teams to understand the relationship between risk, uncertainty, programme and critical path. Monitor the effectiveness of mitigation strategies and assess changes in risk exposure over the project lifecycle. Produce clear and concise risk reporting, dashboards and management information, highlighting key exposures, trends, emerging risks and areas requiring management intervention. Provide risk input into project forecasts, baseline reviews, change management and key project decision-making processes. Identify and analyse emerging risks and opportunities, ensuring these are captured and appropriately assessed. Support the development of risk scenarios and sensitivity analysis to help project teams understand the potential impact of key uncertainties. Maintain appropriate risk governance, ensuring risk data is accurate, auditable and aligned with project controls requirements. Work collaboratively with Project Managers, Project Controls Leads, Planners, Commercial Managers, Cost Managers and senior client stakeholders. Promote a proactive risk and uncertainty management culture, ensuring risk is used as a decision-making tool rather than simply a reporting requirement. Contribute to the continuous improvement of CMR's project risk methodologies, processes, tools and ways of working. Support Senior Risk Managers and Project Controls Leads in delivering high-quality risk management services to our clients. 🔹 We’re looking for: Essential Proven experience in a project risk management role within major construction, infrastructure, engineering or another complex capital project environment. Strong understanding of project risk management methodologies and quantitative risk analysis. Practical experience undertaking or supporting Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA). Practical experience undertaking or supporting Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA). Experience developing, maintaining and interrogating project risk registers and risk models. Strong understanding of the relationship between risk, cost, schedule, contingency and project forecasting. Experience facilitating risk workshops with project and technical stakeholders. Experience assessing probability, impact, uncertainty and risk exposure and translating this into meaningful project insight. Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret complex project data and identify trends and areas of concern. Good understanding of project controls and how risk interacts with planning, cost, commercial and change management. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and constructively influence project teams. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A proactive approach to identifying emerging risks and opportunities and improving project performance. Experience working in a complex, multi-stakeholder project environment. Desirable Experience working on major infrastructure, energy, nuclear, rail, defence or other highly regulated capital programmes. Experience working on projects with significant levels of cost and schedule uncertainty. Experience developing or reviewing Monte Carlo risk models. Experience using quantitative risk analysis tools such as Safran, Primavera Risk Analysis, @RISK, ARM or similar. Experience producing and interpreting P-values, confidence levels, S-curves, tornado diagrams and risk distributions. Experience with risk allowances, contingency setting and probabilistic forecasting. Experience integrating risk models with project cost and schedule models. Experience working within a mature Project Controls function. Recognised project management or risk qualification such as APM, IRM or equivalent. Membership of a relevant professional body. 🔹 At CMR We have a strong culture driven by our 9 Core Principles. We look to build a community of people that share our values and ambitions. Manage the relevant SAP partnership relationships within the territory, including joint account planning, opportunity alignment, co-selling activity and participation in SAP-led initiatives. Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, opportunity stages, next actions, forecasts and pipeline reporting. Represent Westernacher at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and partner activities, with regular travel across the UK & Ireland as needed. Support effective handover to delivery teams and maintain executive customer relationships after contract award to encourage long-term growth. Experience and capabilities: Demonstrable success in selling complex IT consulting, digital transformation or enterprise software implementation services. Experience in the SAP ecosystem is strongly preferred. Proven demand-generation experience, ideally within the IT services or enterprise technology industry, with evidence of converting campaigns and prospecting activity into qualified pipeline. Strong consultative, value-based and ROI selling skills, including the ability to build business cases, quantify benefits and communicate value to executive stakeholders. Experience owning a territory or market segment and translating market insight into practical go-to-market and account plans. Ability to manage long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and coordinate internal and partner teams through to contract closure. Strong commercial judgement, negotiation, presentation and proposal-writing skills. Disciplined CRM, pipeline-management and forecasting practices. Confidence working with customers and partners at all levels, including C-suite and senior functional leaders. Collaborative, proactive and organised, with the independence to take ownership and the judgement to involve colleagues at the right time. Fluent English and excellent written and verbal communication skills. Willingness and ability to travel throughout the UK & Ireland as required. A degree in business, marketing, engineering, science or a related field is welcome, although equivalent relevant experience will also be considered. How success will be measured: Creation and progression of a healthy, qualified territory pipeline. Achievement of agreed bookings, revenue, margin and forecast-accuracy targets. Effective execution of territory go-to-market and demand-generation plans. Strong collaboration with SAP and measurable joint account and opportunity activity. Quality of customer relationships, sales-cycle leadership and handover to delivery. Our promise: Competitive remuneration package. Inspiring and exciting, innovative working environment. Partnership culture with a strong entrepreneurial spirit and opportunity for partnership/co-ownership. Environment of open communication, trust and regular feedback. International company culture and minimal hierarchical structure. Flexible working hours and hybrid working mode. Founded in 1969, Westernacher Consulting is a global business and SAP consulting company represented in 28 countries, with 1,400 consultants across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. As an SAP Gold Partner with over 30 years of experience as an SAP partner, we combine deep industry knowledge, business process expertise and technology innovation to create sustainable value for our clients. We are 100% employee-owned, which shapes our entrepreneurial culture and our commitment to shared responsibility, long-term thinking and sustainable success. We work in partnership, challenge conventional thinking and give our people the opportunity to create meaningful impact for our clients, our company and one another. Westernacher is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions based on qualifications, experience and business needs, in accordance with applicable local law. Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail; comfortable using CRM and sales intelligence tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot). We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here). [OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. [OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. [AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. Join us as an AI Engineer in our AI Products team to make sure the AI agents we ship are as reliable as they are fast to build. You'll design the evals, observability and tooling that keep agent quality high in a regulated bank. ➡️ What you'll do Build agents: You'll develop agents that take real actions for customers. Match rigor to risk: You'll size evaluation to the stakes, because an agent making transfers is not a PR bot. Own evaluation of every feature: You'll make sure every new agent capability comes with the right evaluation strategy, defining what needs to be tested offline and validated online, based on business requirements, expected outcomes and risk. Observe agents in production: You'll build the monitoring strategy that makes agent behaviour visible, tracks performance against business objectives and flags issues early. Scale it as a platform: You'll turn our tools, evaluation practices and monitoring capabilities into a self-service platform that lets other teams build, evaluate and operate their own agents. ➡️ What we're looking for Evaluation mindset: You've evaluated models or LLM systems and know what makes a test misleading. Strong ML foundations: You understand the ML lifecycle, from training and iteration to evaluation and monitoring, and core concepts such as overfitting, generalization and cross-validation. LLM and agentic systems knowledge: You understand the fundamentals of LLMs (particularly the Transformer architecture) and the building blocks of agentic systems. You know how to optimize an agent's harness (prompts, tools, hooks and orchestration) to improve its reliability and performance. Builder instinct and backend comfort: You've built and shipped something used by real users, whether professionally, during an internship or as a side project. You're comfortable reading and writing backend code, working with APIs and integrating systems.
