description: Help shape how enterprise document management technology is evaluated, adopted, and governed at scale. In this role, you will build practical artificial intelligence tooling that makes governance faster, more consistent, and evidence-based. You will partner closely with platform engineers and architecture stakeholders to improve decision quality and reuse across the organization. Your work will directly influence platform standards, capability definitions, and technology assessments. As a Vice President Domain Intelligence Engineer in Document Management Platform, you own day-to-day domain governance and build intelligent tooling that scales how document management technologies are assessed and guided. You evaluate inbound technology requests, maintain the domain capability taxonomy, and identify gaps between demand and platform capabilities. You design and maintain a governed knowledge base and build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows that accelerate assessments with documented, traceable outputs. You communicate recommendations clearly and support architecture forums with consistent, repeatable evaluation methods. Within the first 90 days, you will align key platform initiatives to documented capabilities, complete initial technology assessments using the standard rubric, and publish an initial knowledge base for platform engineering users. Within six months, you will deliver an automated triage workflow that matches requests to capabilities and produces draft, rubric-based recommendations to reduce turnaround time. Within 12 months, you will establish the knowledge base as the trusted reference for domain decisions and keep the capability taxonomy current and defensible for architecture and information security stakeholders. Job responsibilities Serve as the document management domain intelligence lead, owning technology preferences and decision guidance for the domain. Evaluate inbound technology requests (vendor, open-source, and internally developed), map requests to existing capabilities, and route items for further review when needed. Maintain and improve the domain capability taxonomy, ensuring capabilities are current, clearly described, and consistently classified. Identify capability gaps between platform offerings and engineering demand, and translate gaps into structured inputs for the platform roadmap. Apply a rubric-based assessment method consistently, producing documented, defensible recommendations and decision records. Design and maintain a governed, queryable knowledge base covering capability definitions, assessment history, decision records, and platform non-functional requirements. Implement RAG pipelines over authoritative documentation to deliver accurate, citation-backed responses for engineers and stakeholders. Develop agentic evaluation workflows that retrieve relevant capabilities and prior assessments, draft preliminary recommendations, and score requests against the rubric. Build and maintain natural-language query experiences that help users understand capabilities, preferences, and outcomes with governed responses. Instrument governance and assessment workflows with measurable metrics (for example, throughput, coverage, and taxonomy drift) and publish reporting for governance stakeholders. Create proofs of concept when needed to validate assessments and demonstrate whether requests align to existing services or require new capability investment. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Seven or more years of relevant experience in technology governance, architecture review, or platform engineering within a large enterprise environment. Proficiency in Python and experience building production-quality automation, evaluation pipelines, or workflow services. Experience designing and building knowledge bases and RAG solutions, including chunking strategies, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and grounded response generation. Working knowledge of vector search and storage technologies (for example, OpenSearch or Pinecone) and large language model platforms (for example, Amazon Bedrock or Azure OpenAI). Understanding of the applied artificial intelligence lifecycle, including prompt design, evaluation, and output governance for document processing use cases. Knowledge of enterprise content and document management concepts, such as capture, metadata management, lifecycle governance, retention, and search. Experience with cloud services used for document intelligence workflows (for example, object storage, event streaming, and document extraction services). Ability to apply structured, rubric-based evaluation methods and explain recommendations in governance forums. Ability to write clear capability descriptions, assessment reports, and decision documentation for architecture audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under time constraints. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience in regulated industries supporting content in legal, compliance, risk, or operations contexts. Experience using an enterprise technology governance intake and review platform. Familiarity with domain model structures (category, domain, capability) and technology lifecycle stages (invest, maintain, divest, decommission). Experience building agentic workflows or multi-agent systems using common orchestration frameworks (for example, LangChain or LlamaIndex). Familiarity with graph databases (for example, Amazon Neptune or Neo4j) for knowledge graph development and relationship querying. Experience with intelligent document processing capabilities such as optical character recognition, classification, and extraction validation. Relevant cloud or generative artificial intelligence certification.

description: Job summary As a Senior Principal Data Architect at JPMorganChase within the IAM - Data Services Organization, you provide specialized expertise to influence the target state architecture and strategy. Work across teams to implement and advance the adoption of complex, strategic, global data architecture solutions that will give JPMorganChase a competitive advantage. You will build a Data Services platform that connects scattered assurance data into one governed model. That model runs from control objectives through to evidence, findings and verified closure. In 2027 it will prove few use cases on a shared data foundation and semantic model before scaling firmwide . We're looking for an architect who has designed, built and operated semantic models for large-scale applications. You will own the enterprise semantic model at the center of this platform. Job responsibilities Own the design of the enterprise semantic model. This means stable entity identities, typed relationships, constraints and versioning across the chain Control Objective → Procedure → Application → Platform → Evidence → Finding → Closure. Set and enforce firmwide standards for modelling, identity resolution, taxonomy and ontology. Work with function SMEs (for example IGA and PAM) to register domain taxonomies against a common core. Decide when to use graph-native processing and when to use lakehouse/SQL processing, for traversal, impact analysis and graph analytics at scale. Design how the semantic layer fits with the data lakehouse (Databricks bronze, silver and gold layers). That includes how gold contracts feed the graph and how lineage and provenance carry through. Define data contract and schema evolution patterns so changes never surprise consumers. Build point-in-time history into the model so audit evidence packs can be reproduced, and separate configuration evidence from operating evidence. Make sure every output carries entitlements, data minimization and quality state (freshness, coverage, completeness, and whether a value was observed, inferred or derived). This applies to dashboards, APIs, data shares and conversational access. Design deterministic, auditable context for AI agents, with clear control boundaries and human approval checkpoints. Guide producer teams on silver and gold modelling and contract design, and deliver the 2027 proof points. Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to senior technology, Risk and Audit stakeholders. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills A proven record of designing, building and operating semantic models or knowledge graphs for large-scale enterprise applications: many source systems, high-volume entities and relationships, and multiple consuming applications in production. Deep expertise in graph and semantic data modelling, covering entity and relationship design, ontology and taxonomy design, identity and entity resolution, constraint design, and temporal or bitemporal (point-in-time) modelling. Hands-on experience with graph technologies and query languages, such as a property graph or RDF/OWL. You understand where recursive SQL breaks down for traversal, cycles and graph analytics. Strong cloud-native data platform architecture experience, ideally on Databricks or another lakehouse with a bronze/silver/gold (medallion) layout. You can design how a lakehouse and a semantic layer work together. Experience setting and running data contracts, schema versioning and change management across many producer teams. A proven record of setting data modelling standards across many teams and products, and of influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority. Experience with lineage, provenance, data quality and completeness, and entitlement-aware access, including handling sensitive data (for example CCI) at the source. Experience leading safe adoption of firm-approved AI capabilities in data architecture workflows, including validation practices and awareness of data sensitivity. The ability to evaluate and govern AI-enabled architecture patterns, including agentic workflows, with clear control boundaries, auditability and human approval checkpoints aligned to resiliency and security expectations. The ability to evaluate current and emerging technologies and recommend data architecture approaches that reach the target architecture. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience modelling controls, risk, audit or compliance data, such as control-to-evidence mapping, findings and remediation workflows, or continuous control monitoring. Familiarity with identity and access management data (IGA, PAM, entitlements, privileged access). Experience with metadata management, data catalogues, MDM, and lineage or provenance at enterprise scale. AI/ML enablement through graphs (feature generation, embeddings, relationship-aware retrieval or GraphRAG), with strong grounding in data controls. Experience building self-service data platforms (YAML/SQL-declared pipelines, automated deploys, guardrails, quotas and budgets). Experience at a regulated financial institution.

Job summary As a Senior Principal Data Architect at JPMorganChase within the IAM - Data Services Organization, you provide specialized expertise to influence the target state architecture and strategy. Work across teams to implement and advance the adoption of complex, strategic, global data architecture solutions that will give JPMorganChase a competitive advantage. You will build a Data Services platform that connects scattered assurance data into one governed model. That model runs from control objectives through to evidence, findings and verified closure. In 2027 it will prove few use cases on a shared data foundation and semantic model before scaling firmwide . We're looking for an architect who has designed, built and operated semantic models for large-scale applications. You will own the enterprise semantic model at the center of this platform. Job responsibilities Own the design of the enterprise semantic model. This means stable entity identities, typed relationships, constraints and versioning across the chain Control Objective → Procedure → Application → Platform → Evidence → Finding → Closure. Set and enforce firmwide standards for modelling, identity resolution, taxonomy and ontology. Work with function SMEs (for example IGA and PAM) to register domain taxonomies against a common core. Decide when to use graph-native processing and when to use lakehouse/SQL processing, for traversal, impact analysis and graph analytics at scale. Design how the semantic layer fits with the data lakehouse (Databricks bronze, silver and gold layers). That includes how gold contracts feed the graph and how lineage and provenance carry through. Define data contract and schema evolution patterns so changes never surprise consumers. Build point-in-time history into the model so audit evidence packs can be reproduced, and separate configuration evidence from operating evidence. Make sure every output carries entitlements, data minimization and quality state (freshness, coverage, completeness, and whether a value was observed, inferred or derived). This applies to dashboards, APIs, data shares and conversational access. Design deterministic, auditable context for AI agents, with clear control boundaries and human approval checkpoints. Guide producer teams on silver and gold modelling and contract design, and deliver the 2027 proof points. Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to senior technology, Risk and Audit stakeholders. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills A proven record of designing, building and operating semantic models or knowledge graphs for large-scale enterprise applications: many source systems, high-volume entities and relationships, and multiple consuming applications in production. Deep expertise in graph and semantic data modelling, covering entity and relationship design, ontology and taxonomy design, identity and entity resolution, constraint design, and temporal or bitemporal (point-in-time) modelling. Hands-on experience with graph technologies and query languages, such as a property graph or RDF/OWL. You understand where recursive SQL breaks down for traversal, cycles and graph analytics. Strong cloud-native data platform architecture experience, ideally on Databricks or another lakehouse with a bronze/silver/gold (medallion) layout. You can design how a lakehouse and a semantic layer work together. Experience setting and running data contracts, schema versioning and change management across many producer teams. Experience with lineage, provenance, data quality and completeness, and entitlement-aware access, including handling sensitive data (for example CCI) at the source. Experience leading safe adoption of firm-approved AI capabilities in data architecture workflows, including validation practices and awareness of data sensitivity. The ability to evaluate and govern AI-enabled architecture patterns, including agentic workflows, with clear control boundaries, auditability and human approval checkpoints aligned to resiliency and security expectations. The ability to evaluate current and emerging technologies and recommend data architecture approaches that reach the target architecture. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience modelling controls, risk, audit or compliance data, such as control-to-evidence mapping, findings and remediation workflows, or continuous control monitoring. Familiarity with identity and access management data (IGA, PAM, entitlements, privileged access). Experience with metadata management, data catalogues, MDM, and lineage or provenance at enterprise scale. AI/ML enablement through graphs (feature generation, embeddings, relationship-aware retrieval or GraphRAG), with strong grounding in data controls. description: Join the Firmwide Technology Resiliency group within JPMorganChase’s Cybersecurity & Technology Controls organization. The group ensures the firm’s technology estate can maintain effective operations and sustain the critical functioning of Essential Business Services against an evolving threat landscape. Our work underpins the firm's ability to meet global operational resilience expectations, helping to show regulators, clients and the business that critical services can withstand and recover from severe but plausible disruption. We are seeking a Senior Lead Security Engineer to design and build product capabilities that operationalize the management of technology resiliency. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role: you will architect and write production code, set technical direction, and ship platforms consumed directly by operations and development teams across the firm. At the Senior Lead level, you are expected to own the technical strategy for a product area end-to-end - from problem framing and architecture through delivery, adoption, and operational ownership - while raising the engineering bar across adjacent teams. Job responsibilities Design, build, and evolve products that automate resilience management and give teams real-time insight into service health, dependencies, recovery readiness, and controls. Combine telemetry, configuration, topology, change, and control evidence to identify resilience risks. Automate resilience controls across software delivery, including policy checks, guardrails, evidence capture, and drift detection. Generate and validate recovery plans from infrastructure templates and deployed environments, refreshing them as environments change. Provide operational tools such as dashboards, control status views, exception and waiver workflows, recovery playbooks, and runbooks. Automatically capture auditable resilience evidence—including dependency maps, recovery testing results, and control compliance—to support operational resilience and regulatory commitments. Build data pipelines and models that represent service dependencies and resilience posture using graph-based approaches, including dependency graphs, blast-radius analysis, critical paths, and control coverage. Develop analytics to identify risk concentration, single points of failure, configuration anti-patterns, and recovery-readiness gaps. Apply site reliability engineering principles to improve product reliability, scalability, and operability through service level indicators and objectives, instrumentation, error budgets, and automation-first operations. Lead by doing: contribute significant code while driving design reviews, technical direction, and delivery discipline. Mentor engineers and raise standards across peer teams; partner with cyber operations, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, and risk stakeholders to define requirements, sequence delivery, and drive adoption. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 7 years of professional experience in security engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering or support, platform engineering, infrastructure reliability, or a related field. Hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, or improving complex production environments, including building, shipping, or operating production systems. Knowledge of security practices for production technology, including access controls, service accounts, network or service segmentation, platform security, or secure operations. Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience developing scripts, automation, or data solutions for engineering or operational use. Experience with software or service design, including application programming interfaces, and with at least one additional programming language such as Rust, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Experience with cloud-native architecture, containers such as Docker or Kubernetes, and continuous integration and delivery practices. Experience using infrastructure-as-code tools, such as Terraform, to manage infrastructure, environments, or configuration changes. Understanding of secure software development practices and automated engineering controls in build and deployment pipelines. Understanding of high-availability and disaster-recovery patterns across cloud or hybrid infrastructure. Ability to explain technical designs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Cyber operations engineering background, including experience with security operations, cyber telemetry, detection engineering, cyber risk signals, or operational workflows. Data science or analytics experience, particularly with graph technologies such as Neo4j, TigerGraph, or Amazon Neptune, including graph data modeling, query patterns, dependency mapping, and visualization. Hands-on experience implementing policy-as-code or controls-as-code, including rules engines, pipeline gates, and automated evidence collection. Experience generating and maintaining recovery and resilience plans from real infrastructure state, including infrastructure-as-code and runtime discovery, and embedding plans into operational workflows; familiarity with resilience frameworks such as DORA, UK PRA/FCA operational resilience, U.S. Interagency Sound Practices, FFIEC, Basel Principles, or NIST CSF. Experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, to accelerate delivery and improve developer productivity. Proven ability to build collaborative partnerships with technical stakeholders, including technology vendor partners, and to work effectively in a matrixed organization. Experience building and operating observability stacks and telemetry pipelines, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and correlation and triage workflows; in-depth PaaS/IaaS virtualization knowledge, experience across multiple public cloud providers, or both.

description: About the Metropolitan Museum of Art The Met presents over 5,000 years of art from around the world for everyone to experience and enjoy. The Museum lives in two iconic sites in New York City—The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters. Millions of people also take part in The Met experience online. Since its founding in 1870, The Met has always aspired to be more than a treasury of rare and beautiful objects. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and respectful work environment with a staff as diverse as the audiences we engage. Our staff members are art lovers who are passionate about working toward a common goal: creating the most dynamic and inspiring art museum in the world. At The Met, every staff member – from security officers to researchers to scientists and beyond – lives by our core values of respect, inclusivity, collaboration, excellence, and integrity. Respect: Engage one another with collegiality, empathy, and kindness, always. Inclusivity: Ensure that all are and feel welcome and valued. Collaboration: Reach across boundaries to exchange ideas and work together toward our shared mission. Excellence: Lead the cultural world in quality and expertise—and inspire curiosity and creativity. Integrity: Hold ourselves to the highest moral standards, admit when we fall short, and then evolve. ABOUT WATSON LIBRARY Thomas J. Watson Library is The Met's research library. With its collection of more than one million volumes, extensive digital collections, and online resources, Watson Library is one of the world's most comprehensive art libraries. The library's holdings reflect the global and encyclopedic nature of The Met, with books ranging in date from the late fifteenth century to current scholarship, in all fields covered by The Met. The library's mission is to support the research activities of the Museum staff and to offer access and outstanding services to an international community of students and scholars. The staff of the Sherman Fairchild Center for Book Conservation are responsible for the preservation of Watson’s collection, and for other Met departmental collections. GENERAL STATEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: This position performs original and complex copy cataloging adhering to current national and international standards (e.g., RDA, LCNAF, LCSH, PCC); engages in name authority record creation (NACO); contributes to the department’s continued engagement with reparative cataloging practices; and increases awareness, discoverability, and use of the library’s collections through publications, presentations, programs, digitization, and social media. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: Applies specialized subject and metadata expertise, and performs original and complex copy cataloging of library material; Creates high-quality descriptive and technical metadata in MARC and non-MARC formats for physical and digital collections, including serials; Performs original and complex copy cataloging for print and electronic materials following RDA standards in all subjects collected by the library, including materials in Romance and other European languages; Creates and enhances LC/NACO records, and participates in linked data initiatives involving NACO, Wikidata, and other vocabularies; Creates TMS records for library material that is exhibited publicly; Plays a leading role in cataloging material from all Departmental Libraries, as well as managing projects related to the handling of Departmental Library projects; Increases awareness, discoverability, and use of the library’s collections through publications, presentations, programs, and social media; Contributes to the metadata creation of the library’s digital collections; Assists in coordinating the cataloging and processing of library materials by Watson staff, interns, and volunteers; Provides reference assistance and research support to Museum staff and visiting researchers in Watson, including 3-4 weekend days per year; Maintains a course of professional development through participation in professional associations or other professional activities external to the library, and brings best practices and innovative approaches to Watson Library; Other duties as assigned. REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS: ALA-accredited master’s degree in library or information sciences required; M.A. in Art History or significant experience working in the humanities preferred Five years’ experience in a professional position in a museum or academic library required At least five years of experience in original and complex copy cataloging, with demonstrated fluency in cataloging print, digital, continuing resources, and online resources required Experience with OCLC Connexion, MarcEdit, OpenRefine, and an integrated library system required Experience creating records in TMS preferred Experience creating and updating NACO records and coordinating linked data initiatives that involve NACO records preferred Experience with automated methods to improve or enhance bibliographic records and metadata at scale preferred Excellent instruction and communication skills, and the ability to provide high-quality reference services and to make presentations to a broad range of researchers from novice to advanced required Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including curatorial and research staff, fellows, and local academic programs required Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish positive and productive collaborations with library colleagues and museum staff required Ability to plan, manage, and oversee multiple projects, meet deadlines, and prioritize work in alignment with the strategic goals of the library and the Museum required Ability to perform detailed work accurately and independently required Knowledge of cataloging and classification practices, standards, and schema such as MARC, RDA, AACR2, LCSH, and Program for Cooperative Cataloging standards (NACO, SACO, BIBCO) required Reading knowledge of at least one Romance or other European language; proficiency in a second and third language strongly preferred Experience with large cataloging projects preferred COMPENSATION: Pay Rate: $95,000 - $105,000 The advertised pay scale reflects the good faith minimum and maximum salary range for this role. The advertised pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage for any specific employee. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, special licensing or qualifications, and other factors. Location Requirements At time of employment, employees are expected to be located within commuting distance of the Museum. “Commuting distance” means that they are located in one of following states: New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, or Pennsylvania (the “Tri-state and PA” areas), and be able to commute to and from the Museum in a single day. Benefits Offerings The Museum provides competitive compensation, and generous benefits and perks for all eligible employees. Note: Benefits Offering may differ based on Employee Status. Medical, dental, vision and life insurance 403(b) basic retirement plan and optional matching retirement plan with an outstanding employer match Considerable paid time off, including annual leave, sick leave, and 13 Museum holidays Long-term disability coverage Flexible Spending Accounts & Health Savings Account (pre-tax income for eligible health care expenses) Commuter benefits (pre-tax income for parking or mass transit expenses) Free financial-planning services Financial assistance for relevant coursework, seminars, and training programs 25% discount for staff in Museum shops A subsidized staff cafeteria Access to the Museums Council pass, which grants free admission to various museums and cultural institutions We recognize that it is highly unlikely that someone meets 100% of the desired attributes for a role. If much of this job description describes you, then please apply for this role. The Met is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, The Met will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed in this process, please contact benefits@metmuseum.org . The Metropolitan Museum of Art provides equal opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, mental or physical disability, pregnancy, alienage or citizenship status, marital status or domestic partner status, genetic information, genetic predisposition or carrier status, gender identity, HIV status, military status and any other category protected by law in all employment decisions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, training and apprenticeship, promotion, upgrading, demotion, downgrading, transfer, lay-off and termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

description: 岗位名称： FDE实习生 - Accelerator Team 工作性质： 全职实习生 招聘人数： 1-2人 工作地点： 北京 组别简介 自创院以来，微软亚洲研究院 Accelerator Team致力于连接研究、人才、创新生态，以及不同国家与区域，构建开放协同的创新网络。该团队加速研究的同时推动创新从实验室走向真实世界，赋能微软亚洲研究院打造面向未来的 AI 创新生态。 当下，该团队致力于探索 AI-Native 的创新工作方式，并将前沿人工智能能力转化为可落地的应用与工具。团队聚焦大语言模型、AI Agent、检索增强生成（RAG）、工作流自动化及知识管理等方向，通过快速原型、真实场景验证和持续迭代，提升团队生产力、协作效率与组织创新能力。 工作职责 1. 与 Accelerator 团队紧密合作，围绕科研协作、人才发展、知识管理及组织智能等真实场景，设计并构建 AI Native 应用、智能 Agent 与自动化工作流，助力提升研究效率与创新能力。 2. 快速理解开放性问题，将复杂需求转化为可落地的 AI 解决方案，通过快速原型开发、持续实验与迭代验证，不断优化真实用户场景中的产品体验与价值。 3. 参与 AI Native 产品的全生命周期，包括需求分析、方案设计、技术实现、效果评估、部署优化及持续迭代，共同推动创新项目落地。 任职要求 计算机、工程或其他相关专业的本科、硕士或博士在读或者gap-year学生优先，同时欢迎具备相关能力和项目经验的跨学科同学申请。 具备良好的编程能力，熟悉至少一种主流编程语言，能够熟练运用 AI 辅助编程（Vibe Coding）完成原型开发，并具有实际项目经验。 乐于探索 AI-Native 的工作方式，能够快速学习和应用新工具、新技术与新框架，通过快速验证和迭代提升团队协作与工作效率。探索并应用前沿 AI 技术，包括大语言模型（LLMs）、AI Agents、多 Agent 协作、Context Engineering、RAG、Knowledge Graph、Memory、Tool Use 等，推动 AI 在科研组织中的创新应用。 具备良好的沟通与协作能力，能够理解开放性需求并将其转化为可落地的 AI 解决方案。 能够熟练使用英语作为工作语言。 能够获得导师的书面同意。 加分项（满足任意一项即可） • 有 AI Agent、Copilot、LLM 应用或 AI 自动化工具相关项目经验。 • 有使用 OpenAI API、Azure AI 或其他 AI 平台完成实际项目的经验。 • 有个人 AI 项目、Hackathon、开源项目或产品开发经验。 • 有 Workflow Automation、知识管理、数据分析或内部效率工具开发经验。 • 乐于尝试新技术，并能够快速将新的 AI 能力应用到真实场景中。 实习时间要求 能获得导师许可，并保证至少三个月的全职实习。 申请方式 请下载并填写申请表（ https://aka.ms/InternApplication ），并将申请表与完整的中英文简历（PDF/Word 格式）一同发送至 MSRAih@microsoft.com。邮件标题请注明： FDE实习生-Accelerator Team 了解更多“明日之星实习生计划”： https://www.msra.cn/zh-cn/connections/academic-programs/tomorrowstars

description: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision:  At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.   As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. Job Summary:   As a Senior  AI Solutions Architect at Neo4j, you will drive transformative change by designing, building, and deploying innovative solutions that combine the power of graph databases and AI. You'll work hands-on to develop scalable, production-grade solutions while acting as a trusted advisor to strategic customers, translating complex data challenges into tangible business value. This involves collaborating closely with customer executives and technical leaders to understand their specific needs and then leveraging your expertise in graph technologies, LLMs, and AI orchestration frameworks to develop bespoke, production-ready AI applications grounded in real-world context using Neo4j Knowledge Graphs.   Providing hands-on consulting and technical expertise for customer engagements will be central to your role. You'll collaborate with Neo4j's most strategic customers on projects that revolutionize their businesses. You'll also collaborate with key Neo4j cloud partners to deliver joint consulting services, offering technical guidance and best practices.  Key Responsibilities: Solution Architecting:  You will work with customer technical leads, customer executives, and partners to manage and deliver successful implementations of Graph+GenAI solutions becoming a trusted advisor to decision-makers throughout the engagement. You will propose solution architectures and manage the deployment of Graph+GenAI solutions according to complex customer requirements and implementation best practices. You will work directly with customers to understand their business objectives and translate them into AI-powered solutions that leverage graph databases and LLMs. This includes gathering requirements, understanding existing data landscapes, and identifying opportunities to apply graph-based AI to solve business challenges. You will interact with customer stakeholders to manage project scope, priorities, deliverables, risks and issues, and timelines for successful customer outcomes. Solution Engineering:  You will develop, test, and deploy production-ready AI applications that integrate graph databases with LLMs and orchestration frameworks. This involves writing production-level code, optimizing for performance and scalability, and ensuring seamless integration with customer systems. Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, scalability, and efficiency of deployed AI applications, incorporating new techniques and technologies as they emerge.   Education & Enablement: You will work with other teams at Neo4j (Product and Marketing) to influence the roadmap and provide insights from the field, and package approaches, best practices, and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets. You will share your expertise internally with other Neo4j teams and also with customers through workshops, training sessions, and documentation to empower them to effectively utilize, maintain, and reproduce the AI solutions you deliver. Maintain continuous learning and stay up-to-date with the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape, proactively seeking knowledge of new trends and technologies. Required Qualifications:   Enterprise Application Development : 5+ years of experience in designing and developing enterprise-class applications, demonstrating a strong understanding of software development lifecycle principles. LLM Proficiency : 2+ years of Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating LLMs into applications. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of different LLM providers and their strengths and limitations (e.g., OpenAI’s GPT and O families, Anthropic’s Claude family, Google’s Gemini, xAI’s Grok, as well as open-source LLMs like LLama, DeepSeek, and Mistral). Programming Proficiency : Competence and hands-on experience in at least one of the following languages: Java, JavaScript, Python, or C#. Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code is essential. Deployment and Version Control : Hands-on experience with deployment software on major platforms, such as Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes, and proficiency in source control software, including Git and SVN. Cloud Computing Expertise : Practical experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and demonstrated proficiency in deploying applications within cloud environments. Generative AI Ecosystem Knowledge : Deep understanding of the generative AI ecosystem, including AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Llama Index, Haystack) and cloud provider AI offerings (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure Machine Learning). Data Expertise : Strong foundation in data engineering, data analytics, or data science, with the ability to work effectively with various data types and sources. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision:  At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.   As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Role Join the team behind Neo4j Graph Analytics for Snowflake , our Snowflake Native App that brings the full power of Neo4j Graph Data Science directly into customers' Snowflake accounts, with no data movement required. You'll work on a product that lives natively inside Snowflake: a containerized Java + Python runtime, a SQL-first API, and a release pipeline that ships graph analytics to enterprise data platforms. Our customers are data engineers and data scientists across financial services, supply chain, telco, and beyond, who use it to run PageRank, community detection, pathfinding, and node embeddings against the warehouses where their data already lives. This is a hands-on, mid-to-senior role at the intersection of graph analytics, cloud-native distribution, and DevOps , with a meaningful say in the platform's technical direction. What You'll Do Build and evolve the Neo4j Graph Analytics for Snowflake application, embedding Neo4j Graph Data Science into the Snowflake platform. Design and improve our SQL-facing API : stored procedures, UDFs, and the surface area customers call from their warehouses. Own significant parts of the build, release, and deployment pipeline : Snowflake CLI, Gradle, container images, and the Java/Python runtimes that execute inside Snowpark Container Services. Improve the platform's security posture : caller's rights vs. owner's rights stored procedures, restricted caller's rights (RCR), grants, and proactive image scanning. Collaborate with customers and Solution Engineers to turn real-world requirements into scalable features. Contribute to operational excellence : runbooks, release processes, observability, and reproducible dev environments. Strong SQL skills and real experience integrating with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar). Solid grounding in at least one of Java or Python , and willingness to be effective in both. evidence.phrase: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Role: We are aiming to hire someone in the the UK, Czechia or Italy. Product Engineering at GraphAware offers a unique opportunity to build real-world intelligence systems that matter. Build with purpose: Your code will help law enforcement and analysts save lives and protect communities through better data insight. Innovative tech: Work with knowledge graphs, workflow engines, LLMs, and graph-native UIs pushing the boundaries of data analytics. Shape the future: Contribute to product direction and technical vision alongside a senior engineering team. True autonomy: Own your work, from ideation to deployment.Global mindset: Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, data scientists, and product thinkers across Europe and beyond. Growth without bureaucracy: Develop your skills in a non-micromanaged, excellence-driven environment. What you will be doing As Tech Lead, you will own core parts of the platform layer of GraphAware Hume, our graph-powered analytics platform — the foundations that cut across every development group and that every feature team builds on. You'll be sought out across the organisation for technical guidance on graph architecture, and expected to anticipate issues at the product level before they surface. Neo4j sits at the heart of the product, we need someone who goes beyond using it well, and actively tracks new features, tests them against real workloads, and identifies where they can move the product forward. Working hands-on with Neo4j at the heart of the product, you will drive the architecture that lets us model, query, and scale the knowledge graphs our users depend on. Your responsibilities will include: Driving platform architecture, setting technical direction for the transversal foundations that feature teams across Hume build on, and shaping cross-cutting design decisions with the wider engineering group Owning our Neo4j strategy : actively tracking and hands-on testing of new releases and ecosystem tooling (GDS, APOC, etc.) to assess breaking changes, propose new product opportunities, and plan deliberate, scalable migrations. Optimizing Cypher queries and graph access patterns for latency, throughput, and scale Mentoring engineers and raising the team's technical bar (especially in Neo4j), without formal management authority Partner closely with Product Managers: to translate long-term product goals into scalable technical roadmaps Designing secure, scalable access control systems for mission-critical environments Building APIs for intuitive user interaction with complex data Orchestrating workflows to automate graph analytics, inference, and real-time insights What you must know already and be excited to grow further Deep, hands-on Neo4j expertise, including advanced Cypher query performance optimization, profiling, and deep familiarity with the broader Neo4j ecosystem (e.g., GDS, APOC, drivers). Modelled real domains as property graphs and can reason about nodes, relationships, labels, and properties as a first-class design activity (relational modelling with e.g. PostgreSQL is a plus) Track record of leading architecture and technical direction for a team or product area, not just contributing to decisions made by others Proven ability to drive consensus: across engineering teams for large-scale architectural changes. Proven experience in backend systems (8+ years) with exposure to large-scale, complex applications and cross-functional teams Fluency in Java (or a strong JVM background you can bring to a Java codebase) , with a deep understanding of modern software engineering principles, including: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Test-Driven Development (TDD) Advanced debugging and profiling techniques, Writing composable, maintainable, and testable code Spring or similar frameworks with emphasis on building secure, modular, and scalable APIs Working knowledge of modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and automated deployment workflows Strong security mindset , with practical knowledge of secure software design and common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP) Comfortable with remote team collaboration , i.e. tools and practices for asynchronous communication Bonus points for familiarity with: Knowledge graphs and GraphRAG: building knowledge graphs and grounding LLMs with graph-based retrieval (e.g. neo4j-graphrag, LangChain, LlamaIndex) Graph algorithms and analytics: (pathfinding, centrality, community detection) via Neo4j GDS, plus event-driven architectures, Kafka, or distributed systems Evolving large graph data models: over time: schema refactoring, migrations, and versioning as the domain grows Cloud-native development: observability, and performance tuning Italy only: The gross annual salary (RAL) range for this role when based in Italy is €60.000-€75.000. Salary is set individually for each candidate, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria such as experience, skills and scope of responsibility. Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history. 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. description: Who We Are At RelationalAI , we’re solving one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence: how to teach large language models the logic, semantics, and business context of the modern enterprise. Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand your business. We fix that. RelationalAI has pioneered a breakthrough called Superalignment — technology that enables LLMs to learn natively from private, structured enterprise data inside the data cloud. By combining this with relational knowledge graphs and our proprietary neuro/symbolic-relational reasoners , we deliver trustworthy decision intelligence : systems that use semantic models to truly understand how a business operates and can reason across its data to drive better outcomes. We’re a globally distributed team of engineers, scientists, and builders redefining how AI learns from data. We believe that high-stakes decisions deserve frontier intelligence — intelligence that’s explainable, aligned, and grounded in reality. If you’re driven by curiosity, thrive in complexity, and want to help build the system that brings true understanding to enterprise AI, you’ll feel right at home here. The Role You will be embedded inside our customers' hardest problems, and you will own the outcome until it works in production. You'll sit with executives, domain experts, and data teams to find the decisions that actually move their business - inventory that's in the wrong place, risk concentrations nobody can see, fraud patterns that only emerge across three systems, capacity plans built on guesses. Then you'll model their world in our ontology, formulate the reasoning problem, write the PyRel, and ship something that runs against their real data in their own Snowflake account. Every engagement here produces two deliverables. The first is the one the customer sees: a working decision system that changes how they operate. The second is the one that matters most to us: the pile of things you had to invent because our platform didn't have them yet. The modelling pattern you hand-rolled. The constraint formulation that should have been a primitive. The three-hour workaround where an API should have existed. You bring those back, you argue for them, and the strongest of them become product. That second deliverable is why this role exists. If you only ever deliver the first one, we've hired a consultant. We're not hiring consultants. You'll operate with unusual autonomy: you decide what's worth building, when a workaround is acceptable and when it's technical debt we'll regret, and when to tell a customer their real problem is not the one they asked about. You'll be technical enough that when something breaks in a customer environment, you find the root cause yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting. Bring back reproductions, patterns, and specific failure modes ("the only way I could express this was by abusing X in this way"), not vibes. You are one of the loudest inputs into our roadmap. Run technical discovery that gets to the truth - workshops, demos, and proofs of concept designed to find out whether we can actually solve the problem, not to look impressive. Leave things better than you found them - document as you go, in the repo, same week. Turn one-off work into reusable reference implementations so the next person starts where you finished. Employees who excel in this skill have specialized abilities in mathematics, programming, and data analysis, making them highly coveted in the tech industry. Employees who excel in this skill have a high level of technical expertise in programming, data modeling, and data visualization. Agentic Orchestration Ability to design, delegate, and supervise multi-agent workflows involving autonomous AI agents with multi-step reasoning and coordination. Employees who excel in this skill manage task decomposition, agent communication, error handling, quality human validation, and design agent harnesses for long-running tasks, context durability, tool lifecycle, and sub-agent coordination. Semantic Retrieval Ability to design, implement, and optimize semantic search and retrieval architectures including RAG pipelines, knowledge graphs, and hybrid vector/keyword search systems and Lakehouse architectures. Employees who excel in this skill have deep expertise in embedding models, retrieval optimization techniques, and modern data architecture patterns. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. You will help build and scale the layer that makes that possible. This may include the following: Leverage deep SAP data and process understanding — including SAP data models, metadata structures, and end-to-end business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce — to build AI and semantic data solutions using SAP master data domains, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub assets. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers. Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows. Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes. Design, develop, evaluate, and operationalize end-to-end machine learning and AI solutions — from data preprocessing, feature engineering, experimentation, and validation through to deployment, production handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Apply advanced methods across machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, data mining, optimization, and applied AI to solve enterprise-scale problems. Develop AI capabilities — including generative AI and LLM-based solutions — using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Partner closely with product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and production-ready. What you'll bring: Required Qualifications Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative fields. 10+ years of experience to include deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, and LLMs, with hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and improving models using real-world datasets — including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and experimentation — and strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills. 10+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, applied AI, AI research, knowledge engineering, or semantic data systems in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, including production-grade Python development and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn. Demonstrated experience of deploying, shipping, and operating AI or machine learning solutions in production environments, including production handoff and lifecycle support. Experience with big data infrastructure, data processing and transformation tools such as Databricks, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer-facing skills, with significant experience in agile development environments and a strong curiosity for exploring new AI techniques and their practical applications for SAP customers and products. Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end, including how process semantics map to underlying business objects and datasets. Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack — including SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub — with working knowledge of SAP master data domains and Master Data Governance constructs. Hands-on experience designing and maintaining enterprise ontologies using OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, and SHACL, with proficiency in SPARQL, Cypher, and GQL, and experience evaluating trade-offs between RDF triple stores and labeled property graph databases. Experience building entity resolution, deduplication, and identity stitching pipelines across SAP and non-SAP systems, with proven ability to harmonize data into a unified semantic layer using federation, virtualization, replication, and shared ontology mapping approaches. Understanding data product and data mesh principles, including semantic contracts and governed self-service consumption. Proven experience translating abstract business challenges into concrete AI solutions, delivering from concept through production deployment, production handoff, and business adoption. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders — including product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams — in agile software development environments and enterprise product organizations. Experience building AI capabilities using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, or business process intelligence. Preferred Qualification Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, shared AI services, or AI capabilities adopted across multiple product areas. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards, map application-specific schemas to shared ontologies using declarative mapping standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks and canonical business entity models across complex application landscapes. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers. Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows. Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes. What you'll bring: Required Qualifications Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative fields. 10+ years of experience to include deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, and LLMs, with hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and improving models using real-world datasets — including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and experimentation — and strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills. 10+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, applied AI, AI research, knowledge engineering, or semantic data systems in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, including production-grade Python development and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn. Demonstrated experience of deploying, shipping, and operating AI or machine learning solutions in production environments, including production handoff and lifecycle support. Experience with big data infrastructure, data processing and transformation tools such as Databricks, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer-facing skills, with significant experience in agile development environments and a strong curiosity for exploring new AI techniques and their practical applications for SAP customers and products. Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end, including how process semantics map to underlying business objects and datasets. Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack — including SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub — with working knowledge of SAP master data domains and Master Data Governance constructs. Hands-on experience designing and maintaining enterprise ontologies using OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, and SHACL, with proficiency in SPARQL, Cypher, and GQL, and experience evaluating trade-offs between RDF triple stores and labeled property graph databases. Experience building entity resolution, deduplication, and identity stitching pipelines across SAP and non-SAP systems, with proven ability to harmonize data into a unified semantic layer using federation, virtualization, replication, and shared ontology mapping approaches. Understanding data product and data mesh principles, including semantic contracts and governed self-service consumption. Proven experience translating abstract business challenges into concrete AI solutions, delivering from concept through production deployment, production handoff, and business adoption. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders — including product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams — in agile software development environments and enterprise product organizations. Experience building AI capabilities using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, or business process intelligence. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, shared AI services, or AI capabilities adopted across multiple product areas. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. Employees who excel in this skill have a high level of technical expertise in programming, data modeling, and data visualization. title: Data Science Leader - Finance

description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As part of our Data and Applied Science team, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What you'll build: The Data and Applied Science team will build the semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You will help build and scale the layer that makes that possible. This may include the following: Leverage deep SAP data and process understanding — including SAP data models, metadata structures, and end-to-end business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce — to build AI and semantic data solutions using SAP master data domains, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub assets. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models to improve interoperability, entity consistency, and business context across SAP and non-SAP data landscapes, harmonizing sources such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external data providers into unified semantic or analytical layers. Work with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to support reliable AI workflows. Translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI use cases, technical designs, and measurable business outcomes. Design, develop, evaluate, and operationalize end-to-end machine learning and AI solutions — from data preprocessing, feature engineering, experimentation, and validation through to deployment, production handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Apply advanced methods across machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, data mining, optimization, and applied AI to solve enterprise-scale problems. Develop AI capabilities — including generative AI and LLM-based solutions — using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Partner closely with product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and production-ready. What you'll bring: Required Qualifications Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative fields. 15+ years of experience to include deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, and LLMs, with hands-on experience developing, evaluating, and improving models using real-world datasets — including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and experimentation — and strong analytical and mathematical modeling skills. 15+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, applied AI, AI research, knowledge engineering, or semantic data systems in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, including production-grade Python development and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn. Demonstrated experience of deploying, shipping, and operating AI or machine learning solutions in production environments, including production handoff and lifecycle support. Experience with big data infrastructure, data processing and transformation tools such as Databricks, and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer-facing skills, with significant experience in agile development environments and a strong curiosity for exploring new AI techniques and their practical applications for SAP customers and products. Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end, including how process semantics map to underlying business objects and datasets. Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack — including SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub — with working knowledge of SAP master data domains and Master Data Governance constructs. Hands-on experience designing and maintaining enterprise ontologies using OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, and SHACL, with proficiency in SPARQL, Cypher, and GQL, and experience evaluating trade-offs between RDF triple stores and labeled property graph databases. Experience building entity resolution, deduplication, and identity stitching pipelines across SAP and non-SAP systems, with proven ability to harmonize data into a unified semantic layer using federation, virtualization, replication, and shared ontology mapping approaches. Understanding data product and data mesh principles, including semantic contracts and governed self-service consumption. Proven experience translating abstract business challenges into concrete AI solutions, delivering from concept through production deployment, production handoff, and business adoption. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders — including product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams — in agile software development environments and enterprise product organizations. Experience building AI capabilities using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, or business process intelligence. Preferred Qualification Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, shared AI services, or AI capabilities adopted across multiple product areas. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards, map application-specific schemas to shared ontologies using declarative mapping standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks and canonical business entity models across complex application landscapes. Where you belong: Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team defining how enterprise AI actually works on a global scale. You'll work alongside curious engineers, thoughtful product minds, and applied researchers all focused on building AI that customers can trust in the highest-stakes business processes. There's room to grow into new technical spaces, ship real impact, and shape SAP's AI future. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. description: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What you'll build The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll build and scale the layer that makes that possible. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers into unified semantic layers. Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Develop AI capabilities including generative AI and LLM-based solutions using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Work with cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP to support reliable, scalable AI workflows. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. What you'll bring Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, semantic data systems, applied AI, or data science in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field Hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies and semantic models; proficiency in at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL); understanding of trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in agile environments. Preferred Qualifications Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end. (SAP knowledge is a strong accelerator) Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Deep expertise across the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) and/or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL). Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, with experience developing, evaluating, and improving models on real-world datasets. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, or shared AI services adopted across multiple product areas. Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks across complex application landscapes. Understanding of HR/HCM domain semantics and the ability to translate SuccessFactors business concepts, processes, and terminology into semantic models, knowledge representations, AI grounding, and agentic experiences. Experience working with SAP SuccessFactors extensibility and integration technologies, including OData APIs, Integration Center, SAP BTP, and/or other SAP integration patterns. Experience applying analytics, machine learning, or statistical methods to workforce use cases such as attrition, headcount, workforce planning, skills, compensation, recruiting, performance, engagement, or talent intelligence. Where you belong Join SAP SuccessFactors at a pivotal point in the evolution of enterprise AI, where we are moving beyond traditional applications and analytics toward intelligent, autonomous agents that can understand HCM context, reason over trusted business data, and help customers make better workforce decisions. You will collaborate with product, engineering, data, and research teams to ground autonomous agents in SuccessFactors business processes, semantics, policies, and data, while building solutions that are accurate, responsible, secure, and scalable. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What you'll build The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers into unified semantic layers. Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in agile environments.
