(SAP knowledge is a strong accelerator) Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Deep expertise across the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) and/or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL). Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, with experience developing, evaluating, and improving models on real-world datasets. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, or shared AI services adopted across multiple product areas. Understanding of HR/HCM domain semantics and the ability to translate SuccessFactors business concepts, processes, and terminology into semantic models, knowledge representations, AI grounding, and agentic experiences. We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. The context engine that makes AI enterprise ready. Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP’s Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What you'll build The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll build and scale the layer that makes that possible. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers into unified semantic layers. Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Develop AI capabilities including generative AI and LLM-based solutions using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Work with cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP to support reliable, scalable AI workflows. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. What you'll bring Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, semantic data systems, applied AI, or data science in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field Hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies and semantic models; proficiency in at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL); understanding of trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally in agile environments. Preferred Qualifications Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end. (SAP knowledge is a strong accelerator) Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Deep expertise across the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) and/or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL). Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, with experience developing, evaluating, and improving models on real-world datasets. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, or shared AI services adopted across multiple product areas. Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks across complex application landscapes. Understanding of HR/HCM domain semantics and the ability to translate SuccessFactors business concepts, processes, and terminology into semantic models, knowledge representations, AI grounding, and agentic experiences. Experience working with SAP SuccessFactors extensibility and integration technologies, including OData APIs, Integration Center, SAP BTP, and/or other SAP integration patterns. Experience applying analytics, machine learning, or statistical methods to workforce use cases such as attrition, headcount, workforce planning, skills, compensation, recruiting, performance, engagement, or talent intelligence. #dlhiring #LI-MM10 Where you belong Join SAP SuccessFactors at a pivotal point in the evolution of enterprise AI, where we are moving beyond traditional applications and analytics toward intelligent, autonomous agents that can understand HCM context, reason over trusted business data, and help customers make better workforce decisions. As part of the SuccessFactors Line-of-Business, you will work at the intersection of HCM domain expertise, enterprise data, applied AI, and agentic technologies—helping shape how employees, managers, HR leaders, and businesses interact with SAP through intelligent experiences. You will collaborate with product, engineering, data, and research teams to ground autonomous agents in SuccessFactors business processes, semantics, policies, and data, while building solutions that are accurate, responsible, secure, and scalable. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact problems across the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and talent to workforce planning, analytics, and people intelligence, and to play a foundational role in defining the next generation of AI-powered HCM at SAP. Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. title: Senior Data & Applied Scientist - Ontologies & Semantics

description: About us At Triply, we believe smart technology can make a real difference. We help organizations turn scattered data into clear, actionable insights using our software and services for linked data production systems. Our TriplyDB platform enables companies worldwide, from start-ups to organizations with 10,000+ employees, to integrate their data into standards-compliant knowledge graphs and unlock its full potential. We work with clients across industries, including governments and social organizations, contributing to projects that truly have impact. Our close-knit team of curious thinkers thrives on making complex information clear and usable, in an open, creative environment where everyone can experiment and build solutions that matter. Your role You’ll contribute directly to the core of our database engine, where performance, scalability, and correctness are paramount. Our system faces two key challenges: Supporting expressive queries over large and evolving datasets. Scaling both horizontally and vertically to handle real-world workloads. You’ll work on: Designing and optimizing storage formats, indexing structures, and query execution strategies. Improving performance and memory efficiency through careful data structure design and benchmarking. Extending our query planner and execution engine to support new features and optimizations. Building advanced indexing strategies (e.g. full-text and geospatial) to enable fast and precise access to complex data. Collaborating with a small, experienced team to design solutions that are both theoretically sound and practical in production. If you enjoy understanding how databases work under the hood—parsing, planning, executing, caching—and you want to help build something unique in the linked data space, this role is for you. Profile You have: 3 to 5 years of experience in systems-level programming (e.g. C++, Rust, or Go). Experience building or extending database engines, query processors, storage systems, or similar performance-critical software. Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and concurrency. Experience with performance profiling and debugging tools (e.g. perf, gdb, Valgrind, flamegraphs). Familiarity with modern development workflows: Git, CI/CD, automated testing. Strong communication skills and the ability to express complex ideas clearly and concisely. Nice to haves: Experience with TypeScript/Node.js and native bindings (e.g. N-API). Familiarity with query planning, cost estimation, or index optimization. Experience with RDF, SPARQL, or graph/semantic data systems. Exposure to containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) or cloud deployment of data systems. Interest in Rust or modern CMake-based workflows. Even if you do not fit the above description completely, you can always apply. We value a curious mindset and a drive to solve problems. Responsibilities Design, Develop & Test Robust Software : Build and maintain performant, secure, and maintainable core components of our database engine. Implement and test features related to query execution, storage, and indexing, ensuring scalability, correctness, and maintainability. Optimize for Real-World Performance: Profile and benchmark complex workloads. Use empirical evidence to guide performance improvements and architectural decisions. Collaborate & Communicate Effectively : Work closely with other engineers on design discussions, reviews, and testing. Communicate technical issues clearly and share knowledge across the team. Pragmatism : Use sound judgment to balance ideal architecture with practical constraints. Refactor where needed, prioritize impact, and maintain a high standard of developer and user experience. Support the Team & Broader Organization : Assist in diagnosing and fixing issues, testing contributions from others, and collaborating with product and support teams when deep technical expertise is needed. What do we offer? A competitive salary based on your skills and experience A friendly, international team 25 days of holiday Laptop and mobile phone will be provided if necessary Pension scheme Hybrid working Personal budget Snacks, coffee, and occasional sweet treats to keep you energized How to apply If you are a talented Software Engineer looking to join a forward-thinking team and make an impact in the world of linked data, we would love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your relevant experience to careers@triply.cc

title: Software Engineer (Database Systems)

description: About the Role This is not a posting for one job. It's an open door for builders who want in on what we're doing. Every hire crosses a line. Before the offer, the work is finding the right person. After the offer, the work has to be right: identity, work authorization, background checks, tax forms, union agreements, credentials. Someone's name is on every one of them. AI agents are taking over the first half. Nobody is taking the accountability for the second. That's us. Onboarded is the API for the workflows that have to be right. We never built I-9 as a feature. We built primitives: an ontology of the worker, the job, the client and the employer, forms written as code, policies kept current, automations that react when a fact changes. More than six million workers have become eligible for work on that engine. Some of the largest HR tech platforms in the world run on it under their own brand. And it's starting to run work that has nothing to do with onboarding at all. An agent can decide. An agent cannot be liable. Every hiring agent being built right now needs a deterministic, auditable layer underneath it. We're building that layer, and we're a small team doing it. If you've read this far and thought "I want to build that," we want to hear from you, even if no role on our careers page fits. What You'll Do We hire for the person first and shape the seat around what you're great at. Here's the work that needs doing: Build the engine. Extend the ontology, the policy engine and the automations framework. Make agents first-class callers through our APIs and MCP server. Build the agent that writes configuration. Turn a policy, a union contract or a customer request into config a human reviews and ships. This is how a small team serves a big market. Deploy into the field. Embed with customers and partners and build their compliance workflows as code. Everyone here gets close to the people who use what we build. Grow the ecosystem. Open doors with the hiring platforms, staffing systems and HR software companies that distribute Onboarded, and turn signed partnerships into live customers. Tell the story. Define a category in public. Write, ship, film and teach how the work that has to be right gets done in the agent era. Make developers love it. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. Job Description Senior Engineering Manager, Ontology Platform About the Team: We are seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to build and lead a team (initially 5-6 engineers) responsible for architecting, building, and operating our enterprise ontology platform. This is a hands-on management role: you will manage and grow the team, set technical direction, and remain deeply hands-on in architecture and implementation decisions rather than operating purely at a planning/oversight level. You'll drive the build-out of a platform that ingests data from a wide variety of source systems, maps it to a canonical ontology, surfaces discrepancies ("breaks") between source data and ontology definitions, and gives business and technical users configurable tools to manage those mappings and exceptions, all in a financial services data environment where scale, correctness, and auditability matter. The ontology solution is built on top of the enterprise's foundational data platform, so close partnership with that platform team is central to this role. Day to Day: Team Leadership & People Management Build, lead, and grow a team of 5-6 engineers, including hiring, performance management, career development, and day-to-day people leadership. Set team structure, priorities, and delivery roadmap in partnership with product/business stakeholders, balancing ontology/mapping work, platform engineering, and production support. Establish team engineering culture and practices: code review standards, on-call/support rotation, sprint or delivery cadence, and technical documentation habits. Stay hands-on: review and contribute to architecture, participate in code reviews, and step into implementation directly on critical or complex components, especially in the platform's early stages. Represent the team and platform roadmap to senior stakeholders, translating engineering trade-offs and capacity into terms business leaders can act on. Set the expectation and standard for agentic SDLC adoption across the team, ensuring engineers use AI coding agents as a core part of their workflow rather than an optional experiment, and lead by example in your own hands-on work. Platform Engineering & Architecture Own the core platform architecture: services, APIs, and data pipelines that ingest source-system data, apply mapping/transformation logic, and persist it against the enterprise ontology at scale. Drive technical decisions on storage and query layers (graph databases, relational stores, or hybrid approaches), including schema/graph modeling, indexing strategy, and performance tuning as data volume and source count grow. Guide the build of the configuration layer of the product itself, the mechanism by which business and technical users define mappings, rules, and exception-handling logic without requiring a code change per source or use case (e.g., a rules engine, mapping DSL, or admin UI backed by well-designed APIs). Ensure the team ships production-quality code for core platform components: ingestion connectors, mapping/transformation logic, rule/validation engines, and reconciliation ("break detection") pipelines. Establish engineering practices for the platform: version control and branching strategy for ontology/schema changes, automated testing (unit, integration, data quality), CI/CD pipelines, and observability (logging, metrics, alerting) for a production data platform. Design for extensibility from day one; new source systems, new business domains, and new rule types should be addable through configuration and well-defined extension points, not one-off engineering work. Adopt and champion an agentic SDLC approach in your own hands-on contributions, using AI coding agents and related tooling to substantially multiply your engineering throughput, targeting materially higher output than traditional development approaches, not incremental gains. Ontology & Data Mapping Define and evolve the enterprise ontology (entities, relationships, attributes, hierarchies) and translate that model into concrete schemas, graph structures, or data contracts that the platform enforces. Lead the technical implementation of source-to-ontology mappings, reconciling differing definitions, granularity, and nuances across systems in code and configuration, not just documentation. Direct the design and implementation of the rules/validation framework that detects breaks between source data and ontology expectations, including how breaks are surfaced, triaged, and resolved within the product. Stakeholder Partnership Leverage the capabilities of the enterprise's foundational data platform as the underlying infrastructure for the ontology solution, rather than duplicating capabilities that already exist there. Build synergies between the ontology platform and the foundational data platform, identifying where existing platform capabilities (storage, pipelines, compute, governance tooling, etc.) can be extended or reused rather than built bespoke. Proactively identify capability gaps between what the foundational data platform provides and what the ontology solution requires, and partner directly with the data platform team to prioritize and resolve those gaps. Collaborate with the data platform team on shared roadmap items, feature build-out, and design decisions that affect both platforms, acting as the ontology platform's technical voice in that partnership. Partner with business stakeholders, data governance, and compliance teams to translate business/regulatory requirements into concrete engineering and product decisions. Manage technical debt and platform evolution over time as new use cases, sources, and scale demands are added. Minimum Qualifications: 8-12 years of software/data engineering experience, including experience designing and building production-grade platforms or services (not primarily analytics/reporting work). Prior experience as an Engineering Manager or equivalent, with direct people-management responsibility (hiring, performance management, career development) for a team of engineers, not solely a tech-lead role without formal management authority. Strong software engineering fundamentals: proficient in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, Go), API design, service architecture, and writing testable, maintainable production code, and comfortable staying hands-on despite management responsibilities. Demonstrated experience designing and implementing data modeling/mapping frameworks, ideally including ontology, knowledge graph, or master-data-style canonical models, and translating conceptual models into working schemas or graph structures. Practical experience with graph databases and/or semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SPARQL) or equivalent experience with alternative modeling technologies, plus the judgment to choose the right tool for the problem rather than defaulting to one paradigm. Experience building configurable, multi-tenant-style platforms or internal products where business users define behavior (rules, mappings, workflows) without engineering intervention, e.g., rules engines, low-code configuration layers, or plugin/connector architectures. Solid database and data engineering skills across relational and non-relational systems, including experience with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, and handling large-scale, heterogeneous data sources. Experience with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, observability/monitoring for production systems. Experience building on top of a shared/foundational enterprise data platform rather than a fully greenfield stack. You are comfortable navigating platform dependencies, advocating for capability build-out with a platform team you don't directly control, and making build-vs-leverage trade-offs. Strong communication skills: able to work directly with business, compliance, and senior stakeholders, and to translate between business requirements and engineering execution for both the team and leadership. Experience in or working with financial services data environments is a plus, given the regulatory, auditability, and data-quality expectations typical of the domain. Practical, hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your development workflow, with a track record of using them to meaningfully increase delivery speed and quality, and the ability to instill that same practice across a team. Would Be Great if You also: Prior experience building or scaling an enterprise ontology, knowledge graph, or MDM platform from early stages through production maturity, ideally as a founding or early technical leader. Experience growing a team from a small initial size (e.g., 5-6) as platform scope and scale increase. Experience with cloud-native architectures and data platforms (e.g., containerized services, managed graph/database offerings, streaming/event-driven pipelines). Familiarity with data governance and metadata management tooling, and how they integrate with an ontology platform. Background in financial services, asset management, or another regulated, data-intensive industry. Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. SS&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.Actual base salary will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, prior experience, education, demonstrated performance, and geographic location.Other States expected base salary for the position is between 185000 USD to 195000 USD.In addition, employees in this role may be eligible for consideration on an annual basis for a discretionary bonus and/or equity awards, such as restricted stock units or stock options, based upon individual and business performance at the company’s discretion. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. description: 1043 - Data Engineer (SQL/Data Modeling/Knowledge Graphs) · Semi-Senior · Remoto · Argentina Ubicación: Argentina Modalidad: 100% remoto Contratación: Relación de dependencia (full-time) Seniority: Semi-Senior (3 a 5 años de experiencia) Industria / Proyecto: LegalTech / Inteligencia Artificial y Gestión del Conocimiento Zona horaria: Argentina (ART / UTC-3) Inglés: Técnico (lectura de documentación) Conocé Darwoft En Darwoft desarrollamos software que genera impacto real. Sobre la oportunidad Estamos Sumando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con sólidos conocimientos en modelado de datos, bases de datos relacionales y diseño de estructuras de información complejas para participar en un proyecto innovador que combina ingeniería de datos, procesamiento de lenguaje natural e Inteligencia Artificial. El desafío consiste en construir los fundamentos de una plataforma de inteligencia legal, tributaria y regulatoria, capaz de interpretar grandes volúmenes de documentación, identificar entidades y relaciones, y transformar esa información en conocimiento estructurado. Vas a trabajar en el diseño de modelos de datos que permitan representar documentos, conceptos, jerarquías y relaciones semánticas, contribuyendo a la evolución de un Knowledge Graph que potenciará soluciones de búsqueda inteligente y arquitecturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Actualmente, el proyecto se encuentra en una etapa clave de modelado e integración de información documental. El equipo trabaja con documentos estructurados, identificando tanto sus componentes documentales como las entidades y relaciones de negocio que contienen. La arquitectura utiliza tecnologías como Neo4j, Cypher, Python, AWS y modelos de lenguaje (LLMs), con una evolución progresiva hacia soluciones más avanzadas de extracción, recuperación semántica y gobierno de datos. No es necesario que seas especialista en Neo4j o GraphRAG. Buscamos una persona con fundamentos sólidos en ingeniería y modelado de datos, capaz de comprender problemas complejos, diseñar soluciones y adaptarse a nuevas tecnologías. ¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos? Modelado de datos: Diseñar modelos conceptuales, lógicos y estructuras de datos que representen entidades, atributos, relaciones, jerarquías y reglas de negocio. Modelado documental: Analizar documentos complejos e identificar sus componentes estructurales, como títulos, secciones, artículos, párrafos y relaciones jerárquicas. Extracción de entidades: Colaborar en el diseño de procesos para identificar entidades y relaciones semánticas dentro de documentos jurídicos y regulatorios. Ingeniería de datos: Diseñar y desarrollar pipelines ETL/ELT para transformar, validar y estructurar información proveniente de diferentes fuentes. Knowledge Graphs: Participar en la construcción y evolución de modelos de conocimiento orientados a grafos, utilizando tecnologías como Neo4j y Cypher. Gobierno de datos: Contribuir a definir modelos, convenciones y reglas que garanticen consistencia semántica entre bases de datos, servicios, APIs y otros componentes de la plataforma. Integración con IA: Trabajar junto a equipos de Data Science y desarrollo en procesos de extracción asistidos por LLMs y recuperación de información. Calidad y precisión: Diseñar mecanismos de validación que permitan identificar inconsistencias, preservar relaciones y mejorar la confiabilidad de los datos. Evolución técnica: Investigar alternativas, evaluar herramientas y proponer soluciones para desafíos de arquitectura y modelado. Colaboración: Participar activamente en mesas de trabajo técnicas, discutir decisiones de diseño y documentar las soluciones implementadas. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años trabajando en Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones relacionadas. Modelado de datos: Experiencia sólida en diseño conceptual y lógico, modelos entidad-relación, definición de entidades, atributos, cardinalidades y relaciones. Bases de datos relacionales: Buen dominio de SQL y conocimiento de normalización, integridad referencial, claves primarias, claves foráneas y restricciones. Ingeniería de datos: Experiencia desarrollando procesos de ingesta, transformación, integración y validación mediante pipelines ETL/ELT. Programación: Experiencia con Python para procesamiento de información, automatización o construcción de pipelines de datos. Análisis de información: Capacidad para interpretar requerimientos complejos y transformarlos en modelos de datos consistentes, escalables y mantenibles. Calidad de datos: Conocimiento de validaciones, consistencia, integridad y buenas prácticas de documentación. Pensamiento crítico: Capacidad para analizar problemas, cuestionar supuestos, proponer alternativas y fundamentar decisiones técnicas. Autonomía: Experiencia trabajando con objetivos funcionales y técnicos que requieren investigación, definición de soluciones y colaboración con distintos especialistas. Adaptabilidad tecnológica: Interés y capacidad para incorporar nuevos paradigmas de modelado, bases de datos de grafos y herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial. Será un plus si tenés experiencia en: Neo4j y Cypher, especialmente modelado de grafos y consultas sobre relaciones complejas. Knowledge Graphs, Property Graphs o bases de datos orientadas a grafos. Procesamiento de lenguaje natural (NLP) y extracción de entidades (NER). Procesamiento de documentos complejos, contratos, textos jurídicos o documentación regulatoria. Ontologías, taxonomías y tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL. Modelado declarativo, JSON Schema u enfoques de Ontology as Code. Arquitecturas RAG, GraphRAG, embeddings y búsqueda semántica. Integración de modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) en pipelines de procesamiento documental. Servicios de AWS y arquitecturas de datos en la nube. Frameworks como LangChain o LlamaIndex. Proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o gestión de conocimiento. ¿Qué hace interesante este desafío? No se trata únicamente de construir pipelines o administrar bases de datos. Vas a participar en una etapa fundamental de un producto que busca transformar información jurídica compleja en conocimiento estructurado, trazable y accesible mediante Inteligencia Artificial. El principal desafío es lograr que la tecnología comprenda cómo se relacionan los datos, preserve el significado de la información y permita construir soluciones de consulta cada vez más precisas. Es una oportunidad para aplicar fundamentos clásicos de ingeniería de datos y evolucionar profesionalmente hacia arquitecturas de conocimiento, NLP, grafos e IA. ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft? description: Identity has become a critical to an organizations security posture. This is true across their entire digital landscape include cloud, traditional on prem and emerging technologies like agentic ai.Britive is at the forefront of a modern approach to delivering identity security with the only modern privileged access management platform that provides unified Privileged Access Visibility, Dynamic Privilege Management and Secrets Governance across infrastructure, platforms & SaaS. Our patent-pending technology is deployed at companies of all sizes around the world, including Fortune 500 companies. We have repeatedly ranked among the hottest Cloud Security startups. Britive is founded by CyberSecurity industry veterans with a successful prior exit and is backed by top-tier VCs. About You You are a passionate Senior Software Engineer who wants to develop and scale our multi-tenant SaaS applications on the AWS platform. You have strong hands-on technical expertise in a variety of big data technologies. From day one, you must be able to hit the ground running and bring all your experience to the team to contribute in the building of a great product. Most importantly, you have a positive “can do” attitude and a passion for delivering technical solutions in a fast-paced startup environment. Your Impact Key Responsibilities: Responsible for design and development of a large-scale data ingestion and analytics. Design and develop data pipelines for real-time and batch data processing for disparate datasets. Develop systems which can store data in highly normalized fashion to allow correlation with other data sources. Collaborate with product management and engineering teams to design and integrate software, conduct code reviews, and troubleshoot product issues. Perform proof of concepts to identify best design options including usage of AWS services. Research integration options for various SaaS/IaaS technologies, including APIs for user administration and incorporate this research in our application integration. What will you need? Required Skills: Prior experience in performing the same role in a SaaS security product company. Minimum 7 years of relevant work experience in similar roles. In-depth knowledge of Java, REST Web Services, SQL, Kafka/Kinesis, EMR/SparQL, Snowflake, AWS Neptune, Gremlin/Tinker-Pop Hands-on experience developing and delivering scalable data lakes, data ingestion and processing pipelines, data access microservices in multi-tenant environments on AWS platform. Outstanding collaboration and communication skills. Ability to effectively collaborate with distributed team. Understand and practice agile development methodology. Nice to Have: AWS Certified Developer certification is highly desired. Understanding of DevOps, microservices architecture and container/Docker technologies. Perks + Benefits: Work from anywhere in the US! We are fully remote (US only, other areas are subject to review). The ideal candidate will have practical experience developing and managing data solutions using Palantir Foundry, along with a strong understanding of Databricks capabilities. The role requires expertise in Foundry development, PySpark transformations, Ontology, Workshop, security and markings, as well as Databricks components such as Unity Catalog, Delta Lake and Delta Sharing. The candidate should ideally have delivered an integration between Palantir Foundry and Databricks, including data migration and reconciliation activities. In addition to technical expertise, the individual will be expected to lead a small technical workstream and collaborate effectively with client architects in an international environment. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and implement data solutions using Palantir Foundry. Work hands-on with Foundry Code Repositories and PySpark transformations. Develop and manage Foundry Ontology and Workshop components. Configure and work with Foundry security, access controls and markings. Work with Databricks components, including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake and Delta Sharing. Design and support integration between Palantir Foundry and Databricks. Perform data migration reconciliation and validation to ensure consistency and accuracy of migrated data. Collaborate with client architects and technical stakeholders to deliver project requirements. Lead and coordinate a small technical workstream, ensuring effective execution and delivery. Communicate technical solutions, project progress and challenges clearly in English. Required Technical Skills Palantir Foundry Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry. Foundry Code Repositories. PySpark transformations. Foundry Ontology. Foundry Workshop. Foundry Security and Markings. Databricks Databricks platform experience. Unity Catalog. Delta Lake. Delta Sharing. Integration & Data Management Experience integrating Palantir Foundry with Databricks. Data migration and reconciliation experience. Strong understanding of data consistency and validation. Highly Preferred Leadership & Communication Skills Ability to lead a small technical workstream. Experience collaborating with client architects and technical stakeholders. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Professional fluency in English. Ability to discuss technical concepts and provide updates in a client-facing environment. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is someone who combines deep hands-on Palantir Foundry expertise with Databricks knowledge and has successfully delivered Foundry–Databricks integration projects. description: About Us: At Liatrio, we enable real transformation. We help industry-leading enterprises break free from legacy systems and adopt AI that reshapes how teams build, deliver, and thrive at scale. We partner directly with enterprise teams to embed AI-native practices into delivery by accelerating modernization, reducing risk, and shipping production-grade AI systems that set the standard for the industry. Our people embed directly inside client organizations, leading hands-on AI enablement and transformations that reshape how entire enterprises build and operate at scale. If you’re ready to lead real AI transformation, this is where you belong. About the Role: We are seeking Senior Forward Deployed Engineers who thrive on shipping production software, solving complex systems problems, and AI-first engineering workflows. As an FDE, you will embed directly within client teams to build production-grade software while transforming and raising the bar for how our clients design, deploy, and scale their systems. You will bring Liatrio's engineering standards, cloud practices, and AI-first workflows into client environments, elevating the overall technical capabilities of their engineering organizations. In this role, you serve as both an engineer and a catalyst for technical and cultural change. description: Overview LMI is seeking an experienced Data Engineer – Army Vantage / Palantir Foundry to support the U.S. Army Training Information System (ATIS) program. This hands-on role will develop, maintain, and improve ATIS data products and integrations, with a primary focus on capabilities delivered through Army Vantage and Palantir Foundry. The Data Engineer will transform authoritative ATIS data into reliable, reusable enterprise data products and ensure Vantage/Foundry capabilities integrate effectively with the broader ATIS data ecosystem. The ideal candidate has hands-on Foundry experience, strong data-engineering skills, and the ability to independently identify and resolve end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS and Vantage/Foundry. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed. Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value. Responsibilities Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance ATIS data products, datasets, pipelines, applications, dashboards, and related capabilities within Army Vantage/Palantir Foundry. Design, build, and sustain production-quality data pipelines and transformations using Python, SQL, PySpark, and native Foundry capabilities. Develop and maintain Foundry ontology objects, relationships, and data models that make authoritative ATIS data understandable, reusable, and accessible to approved users. Integrate authoritative ATIS data with Vantage/Foundry and other Army enterprise data sources while maintaining data quality, lineage, and appropriate access controls. Trace, diagnose, and drive resolution of end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS source data, interfaces, transformations, pipelines, and Vantage/Foundry products. Develop Foundry-native dashboards, applications, reports, and other data products to support Army analytics, visualization, reporting, and mission needs. Implement data-quality validation, monitoring, scheduling, error handling, and other practices necessary to operate reliable production data products. Apply sound software and data-engineering practices, including version control, peer review, testing, documentation, and CI/CD where supported. Work directly with product owners, engineers, architects, analysts, and users to translate mission needs into practical technical solutions and support appropriate use of authoritative ATIS data. Document solutions, share knowledge, and build team capability so ATIS can sustain and extend its data and Foundry capabilities without creating single-person dependencies. Operate as a self-directed member of the Agile team, taking ownership of technical outcomes and independently driving problems toward resolution. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. 4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, or development of production data products. Hands-on experience developing or maintaining solutions in Palantir Foundry and/or Army Vantage, with sufficient familiarity to contribute with limited platform-specific ramp-up. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, analysis, automation, and troubleshooting. Experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines involving complex or disparate datasets. Experience with data modeling, including schemas, keys, relationships, reference data, and transformation of source data into reusable data products. Experience with Foundry ontology, semantic data models, or comparable enterprise data structures. Experience with PySpark, Spark, Pandas, or comparable technologies for transforming complex datasets. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data pipelines, integrations, data-quality issues, and production data products, including tracing problems across source systems and downstream consumers. Ability to work independently from mission intent or a desired end state while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary technical and product teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders. Active DoD Secret security clearance. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience developing and sustaining data products within Army Vantage. Experience integrating DoD/Army authoritative data sources and working with enterprise data-quality, lineage, governance, and access-control requirements. Experience developing Foundry-native applications, dashboards, reports, or custom interfaces. Experience applying software-engineering practices such as Git/version control, peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD to data products. Familiarity with APIs, cloud data services, and enterprise system integration. Experience working within an Agile or SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) environment. Applicable DoD 8140 cybersecurity/workforce qualification, where required. Experience supporting Army, DoD, federal, or other secure/regulated mission systems. Target salary range: $120,000 - $155,000 Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances. Job Locations US-Remote Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Standard Job Description Join Lockheed Martin’s Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company’s AI transformation. As a lead data architect, you will drive the creation of logical data models that underpin our next‑generation data products and enterprise ontology. You will partner with Data Product Owners by architecting data models, data pipelines and ontologies, and ensure consistent semantic definitions across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). The role operates in a Databricks‑centric environment, integrating source systems such as SAP and Apriso upstream, and powering AI agents and analytics applications downstream. By governing and expanding the semantic layer of the corporate data foundation, you will play a key role in the company’s AI transformation. Key Responsibilities Partner with Data Product Owners to capture business requirements and create robust logical data models. Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications. Ensure models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata). Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity. Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards. Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases. Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs. Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements. Advise on the technology stack used in team operations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field. 10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption. Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies. Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development. Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development. Must be a US Citizen. Desired Skills Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows). Experience with federated data models and ontologies. Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork and internal‑customer support. Master’s degree or advanced technical training (optional). Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or comparable big‑data credentials. Experience developing applications leveraging genAI. Pay Information GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $185400.00 - $344400.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $166900.00 - $309900.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $148300.00 - $275500.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $133500.00 - $247900.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc. At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability. Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year. Originally posted on Himalayas

This position is open only to candidates currently residing in the United States. Travel Requirement: 10% travel for client and company in-person meetings. Purpose of this Position The Senior Solution Architect is responsible for designing and guiding enterprise solutions that bring together Mendix applications, connected enterprise data, AI capabilities, knowledge graphs, integrations and intelligent workflows. This role serves as the technical leader for complex client engagements and establishes VeilSun's capabilities across the Siemens and Altair platform stack: Mendix, Graph Studio (formerly Altair Graph Studio and Anzo) and AI Studio (formerly Altair RapidMiner). The position requires someone who can move from business problem to technical architecture, determine how the three layers of the platform should work together, build the first versions personally, and provide hands-on guidance to the teams implementing those solutions. This person will work closely with clients, project teams, developers and practice leadership to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with business outcomes. Business Outcomes Success in this role means VeilSun can confidently design and deliver enterprise AI and knowledge graph solutions, technical teams have clear architectural direction, and clients receive solutions that effectively connect applications, enterprise data, AI and business processes. You will be measured on: Successful architecture and delivery of Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio solutions Quality, scalability, security and maintainability of solution designs Ability to Ensure appropriate consideration of security, identity, permissions, governance, observability, performance and scalability Partner with project managers and client stakeholders to identify technical risks, dependencies, assumptions and tradeoffs Support estimates, technical solutioning, proposals and presales conversations for enterprise AI, knowledge graph and Mendix opportunities Establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, standards and best practices for Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio delivery Mentor Mendix developers and other technical team members as VeilSun expands its enterprise AI and knowledge graph capabilities Stay current with changes across the Mendix, Siemens and Altair ecosystems, including Graph Studio and AI Studio, and help determine when new capabilities should be adopted Decision Authority You have authority to: Define and recommend the technical architecture for assigned Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio solutions Determine appropriate architectural patterns, integration approaches and technology usage within established project and organizational constraints Recommend whether a business capability should be implemented using traditional application logic, workflow automation, AI, machine learning, agentic capabilities or a combination of approaches Establish technical standards and implementation guidance for project teams Require remediation of architectural, security, scalability or maintainability concerns that create meaningful delivery or client risk Escalate technical risks, dependencies or scope concerns that may impact successful delivery Recommend reusable components, reference architectures, tools and patterns for broader practice adoption Provide technical input into project estimates, staffing needs, delivery approaches and solution feasibility Desired Behaviors and Attributes Thinks in terms of the complete business and technical system rather than a single application or technology Is comfortable working through ambiguity and turning loosely defined business problems into clear technical approaches Balances technical sophistication with practical delivery needs and avoids unnecessary complexity Can communicate complex technical concepts clearly to developers, business stakeholders and client leadership Stays hands-on: builds, validates technical decisions and helps teams through difficult implementation challenges Approaches AI pragmatically and understands that AI is not the right solution for every problem Considers security, governance, maintainability, supportability and long-term ownership as part of architecture decisions Coaches and develops others rather than becoming a bottleneck for technical decisions Proactively identifies risks, assumptions, dependencies and areas where additional discovery is required Continuously learns as the Mendix, Siemens, Altair, enterprise AI and knowledge graph ecosystems evolve Failure Patterns We Avoid Treating enterprise AI and knowledge graph work as simply another Mendix development project Defaulting to AI or agentic solutions where straightforward application logic or workflow would be more reliable Designing technically impressive solutions that are unnecessarily difficult to build, support or maintain Building AI capabilities without sufficient attention to security, data access, governance, auditability or human oversight Creating knowledge graphs or semantic models without a clear business purpose Making architecture decisions without considering existing enterprise systems, integration constraints or client capabilities Designing in isolation without involving the developers and teams responsible for implementing and supporting the solution Allowing architectural standards to become theoretical documentation that does not influence actual implementation Becoming a required approval point for every technical decision instead of enabling teams to operate independently Overcommitting to unfamiliar platform capabilities without validating feasibility, effort or delivery risk Required Qualifications Hands-on project experience with at least two of Graph Studio (Altair Graph Studio or Anzo), AI Studio or Altair RapidMiner, and Agent Builder, or completed Siemens partner enablement on these platforms with a build to show for it Knowledge graph fundamentals: RDF, OWL and SPARQL, with SHACL a plus Mendix Intermediate Developer certification or higher with at least one Mendix application shipped, and Advanced certification within 90 days of hire Significant experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions, including leading technical discovery and solution architecture for complex projects US person, able to pass client background checks, working US time zones Ability to travel up to 20% for client workshops and onsite engagements Preferred Capabilities Mendix Advanced or Expert Developer certification, including application design, domain modeling, integrations, security, deployment and performance Experience integrating applications with multiple enterprise systems through REST APIs, OData, events, middleware or similar technologies Experience with RDF graph platforms such as Stardog, Ontotext GraphDB or Amazon Neptune. Property graph experience (Neo4j, TigerGraph, Cypher, Gremlin) is useful background but not a substitute for RDF and SPARQL Understanding of modern AI concepts including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, context engineering, tool use and human-in-the-loop workflows Experience designing or implementing enterprise generative AI, RAG, machine learning or agentic AI solutions, with Python scripting inside pipelines Understanding of cloud architecture, identity and access management, application security, observability and enterprise deployment patterns Experience with Siemens technologies such as Teamcenter, Opcenter, NX, Polarion or Insights Hub Experience with Snowflake, Databricks or similar data platforms Experience in manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, engineering, aerospace and defense, life sciences or other complex enterprise environments Familiarity with concepts such as PLM, MES, digital thread, digital twin, BOM, engineering change management, manufacturing quality or asset lifecycle management Experience mentoring developers or providing technical leadership across delivery teams Compensation & Benefits The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000–$190,000, depending on experience. description: About Outreach Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. The Role We are looking for a Director of Applied Science and Engineering to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of Outreach's Knowledge Graph and contextual AI capabilities. This is a senior leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise in knowledge representation, graph-based learning, and reasoning systems with the ability to build, inspire, and scale a high-performing team. You will own the end-to-end technical direction of a per-tenant contextual knowledge graph that captures the full complexity of each customer's sales environment: accounts, deals, contacts, rep behaviors, competitive landscape, and the signals buried in calls, emails, and CRM activity. This graph is the reasoning backbone of the platform, powering next-best-action recommendations, deal risk signals, coaching suggestions, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI workflows. In this role, you will set the research agenda, define the architecture, hire and grow the team, and drive measurable business impact through applied science innovation. Your Daily Adventures Will Include: Technical Vision & Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical roadmap for Outreach's Knowledge Graph platform, including entity resolution, temporal reasoning, graph-based learning, and contextual inference. Translate business objectives into a coherent applied science strategy that balances research ambition with production delivery. Team Leadership: Build, hire, and lead a team of applied scientists and research engineers. Establish team culture, research rigor, career development frameworks, and a high bar for both scientific quality and production impact. Mentor senior ICs into technical leaders. Knowledge Graph Architecture: Drive the design of per-tenant knowledge graph schemas, ontologies, and data models tailored to the sales execution domain. Own decisions on graph databases, query languages, storage engines, and tenant isolation strategies at scale. Information Extraction at Scale: Oversee pipelines that extract structured knowledge from unstructured conversational and document data (sales calls, emails, CRM notes), including coreference resolution, relation extraction, event detection, and entity linking. Reasoning & Inference Systems: Lead the development of reasoning and inference layers over the knowledge graph to power next-best-action suggestions, deal risk scoring, coaching recommendations, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI decision-making. Representation Learning & Graph ML: Direct research into graph-based models (GNNs, relational embeddings, link prediction, temporal graph networks) over heterogeneous, multi-relational graph structures to support downstream reasoning, retrieval, and recommendation tasks. Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with leaders in Engineering, Product, Design, and Data to align science investments with product priorities. Represent the applied science function in executive reviews, roadmap planning, and technical design reviews. Research-to-Production Pipeline: Establish processes and infrastructure for moving from research exploration to production deployment: experiment tracking, model evaluation frameworks, A/B testing, and continuous model improvement loops. Industry & Academic Engagement: Keep the team at the frontier of knowledge graph research. Foster connections with the academic community through conference participation, publications, and strategic academic partnerships. Our Vision Of You: PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field with a focus on knowledge representation and reasoning, graph neural networks, information extraction, recommender systems or conversational AI and dialogue systems 10+ years of experience in applied science or machine learning, with at least 3 years in a people leadership role managing teams of 5+ applied scientists or research engineers. Demonstrated track record of building and shipping knowledge graph, NLP, or graph ML systems at production scale: not just publishing papers, but delivering measurable business outcomes. Deep expertise in at least three of: knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, information extraction, graph neural networks, temporal reasoning, representation learning, or recommender systems. Strong engineering fundamentals. You can write production-quality code, not just prototype notebooks. Proficiency in Python / Golang; and graph databases or query languages (e.g., Neo4j, SPARQL, Cypher) is required. Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top applied science talent. You have grown ICs into senior technical leaders and built teams with a strong shipping culture. Executive communication skills. You can translate complex research concepts into business impact narratives for C-suite and board audiences. Comfort with deep ambiguity. You will define the problem space, not just solve well-scoped problems. You thrive when chartering new technical directions from scratch. Strong Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for research and model development initiatives, from problem formulation and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring, driving outcomes with minimal oversight. Nice To Have: Experience building multi-tenant knowledge graph systems with per-customer isolation and scale requirements. Background in sales, revenue, or B2B SaaS domains: understanding of deal cycles, pipeline management, and CRM data models. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLM-based systems (RAG architectures, tool-augmented generation, agentic frameworks). Strong communication skills with the ability to translate research concepts into product impact for cross-functional audiences. Publications in top-tier venues (KDD, NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, WWW, SIGIR, etc.) in knowledge graphs, NLP, or graph learning. Experience with graph databases at scale (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar) including performance tuning, query optimization, and multi-region deployment. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration patterns. Track record of building applied science teams from scratch (0→1 team formation). Why Join Us? Foundational Leadership: You will define how Outreach thinks about knowledge representation and contextual reasoning, decisions that shape the platform for years. This is not an optimization role; it is a charter-defining one. Greenfield Architecture: Build the knowledge graph platform from the ground up with the latitude to make foundational technical decisions on schema design, graph infrastructure, and reasoning systems. Scale & Impact: Outreach processes millions of sales interactions across 4,000+ enterprise customers. Your team's work will directly power agentic AI workflows that change how revenue teams operate globally. Executive Visibility: Direct exposure to top leadership in the company. Present research direction and results at the executive level. World-Class Team: Join a culture that values scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and intellectual honesty. Collaborate with senior engineers, product leaders, and data scientists who care deeply about getting it right. Growth into executive level: For the right leader, this role is a path to executive level as the function scales. You will shape not just the technology but the organizational structure of applied science at Outreach. Why You’ll Love It Here ● Highly competitive salary ● 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave ● Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members ● OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000 ● Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC ● 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay ● Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program ● Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military ● Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team ● Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment. Join our team and make a difference in patient care. About the Role Parachute Health is building the most complete and accurate catalog of home medical equipment and supplies in the industry, and that catalog is at the heart of our entire platform. Over the last few months, a consultant improved our in-house design standards, style guide, review practices, and an early set of universal merchandising attributes. We are now hiring someone in-house to take that work over and grow it for the long term. As our Catalog Taxonomist, you will be the expert on our taxonomy, information architecture, and catalog data model. You will serve as the catalog administrator, set and enforce catalog standards, and own catalog functionality enhancements from requirements definition and justification all the way through operational implementation. Reporting to the SVP of Merchandising Operations, you will partner closely with Operations, Product, Design, and Engineering, to make sure the catalog stays accurate, scalable, and easy to work in as we expand into new categories. A large part of this job is working shoulder to shoulder with engineers and a product manager. You will sit with the Cat Crew R&D team, translate merchandising problems into requirements they can build against, and translate technical constraints back into business impact for the rest of the organization. Just as important, you will be the person who notices when the platform is quietly costing the team time or accuracy, names that gap clearly, sizes it, and advocates for fixing it. The groundwork is fairly new, so you will have a solid base to start from and real room to decide where it goes next. You get to grow the skills of an already highly-motivated Merchandising team and make the group even stronger. You will also influence R&D strategy as we build and enhance our catalog software capabilities,and partner with our clinical division as we launch new categories together. What You'll Do Own the standards and structure of the global product taxonomy, category hierarchy, and catalog data model, and evolve them as we expand into new categories. Partner closely with the Cat Crew R&D team to shape near-term catalog software capabilities. Work directly with engineers through scoping, development, and delivery rather than handing off a spec and walking away. Own catalog functionality enhancement requirements end to end: definition, business justification, and the case for prioritization, then drive them forward with the Catalog Product Manager and Engineering. Surface gaps between what the business needs and what the platform does today. Document the workarounds people have quietly adopted, quantify what they cost in time, accuracy, or scalability, and bring that case to Product and Engineering leadership. Serve as the catalog administrator: govern attributes, values, naming conventions, and data-quality standards across the catalog. Maintain and evolve core catalog assets, including the global catalog style guide, training about existing and new functionality, glossary, and design review guide. Interview category managers and subject-matter experts to learn each category's ideal state, balanced with a curiosity about current state workarounds and platform limitations. Lead design reviews for category managers and analysts and provide effective feedback. Up-level the merchandising team's catalog and taxonomy skills, continuing the trajectory started with the contract taxonomist. Drive the standardized identification of sourcing/provenance attributes, including manufacturer, brand, and product line. Set the long-term strategic direction for catalog data management, quality, and governance, and act as the senior authority the organization consults on catalog and taxonomy decisions. Collaborate with our clinical division to launch new categories, making sure the catalog and taxonomy support new clinical use cases. Advance AI-assisted catalog tooling and workflows, such as Claude skills for catalog building and quality monitoring, and codify repeatable processes. About You Deep expertise in taxonomy, information architecture, and metadata or attribute modeling, ideally for a large, complex product catalog. Hands-on experience administering catalog or product information management (PIM) systems and defining data-quality standards. A track record of spotting business gaps and doing something about them. You notice when a process is broken or a tool is falling short, you can articulate the cost in concrete terms, and you can make the case for investment to people who did not ask for it. A track record of turning ambiguous catalog problems into clear requirements, and of justifying and prioritizing enhancement work against business impact. Strong cross-functional partnership skills, and comfort being the in-house authority who sets standards and makes the final call on catalog structure. Systems thinking and a bias to build durable processes, documentation, and tooling rather than one-off fixes. Motivated to up-level a team that is early in building these skills, and open to direct or dotted-line management as the function matures. Healthcare, DME, or medical supplies domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. Knowledge of or experience in semantic web standards OWL and SKOS is a bonus.
